lines: “Ye keci saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatāse, na te gamissanti apāyabhūmiṃ;

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Bahuṃ ve saraṇaṃ yanti, pabbatāni vanāni ca;

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Yo ca buddhañca dhammañca, saṅghañca saraṇaṃ gato;

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Na kevalañca nesaṃ satthā ettakaṃyeva dhammaṃ desesi, apica kho “upāsakā buddhānussatikammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, dhammānussatikammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, saṅghānussatikammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma sotāpattimaggaṃ deti, sotāpattiphalaṃ deti, sakadāgāmimaggaṃ deti, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ deti, anāgāmimaggaṃ deti, anāgāmiphalaṃ deti, arahattamaggaṃ deti, arahattaphalaṃ detī”tievamādīhipi nayehi dhammaṃ desetvā “evarūpaṃ nāma saraṇaṃ bhindantehi ayuttaṃ tumhehi kata”nti āha.
Ettha ca buddhānussatikammaṭṭhānādīnaṃ sotāpattimaggādippadānaṃ “ekadhammo, bhikkhave, bhāvito bahulīkato ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ bhagavā nānappakārehi upāsake ovaditvā “upāsakā pubbepi manussā asaraṇaṃ ‘saraṇa’nti takkaggāhena viraddhaggāhena gahetvā amanussapariggahite kantāre yakkhabhakkhā hutvā mahāvināsaṃ pattā, apaṇṇakaggāhaṃ pana ekaṃsikaggāhaṃ aviraddhaggāhaṃ gahitamanussā tasmiṃyeva kantāre sotthibhāvaṃ pattā”ti vatvā tuṇhī ahosi.

Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ vanditvā abhitthavitvā sirasmiṃ añjaliṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā evamāha “bhante, idāni tāva imesaṃ upāsakānaṃ uttamasaraṇaṃ bhinditvā takkaggahaṇaṃ amhākaṃ pākaṭaṃ, pubbe pana amanussapariggahite kantāre takkikānaṃ vināso, apaṇṇakaggāhaṃ gahitamanussānañca sotthibhāvo amhākaṃ paṭicchanno, tumhākameva pākaṭo, sādhu vata no bhagavā ākāse puṇṇacandaṃ uṭṭhāpento viya imaṃ kāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ karotū”ti.

Atha bhagavā “mayā kho, gahapati, aparimitakālaṃ dasa pāramiyo pūretvā lokassa kaṅkhacchedanatthameva sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, sīhavasāya suvaṇṇanāḷiṃ pūrento viya sakkaccaṃ sotaṃ odahitvā suṇohī”ti seṭṭhino satuppādaṃ janetvā himagabbhaṃ padāletvā puṇṇacandaṃ nīharanto viya bhavantarena paṭicchannakāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ akāsi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Atīte kāsiraṭṭhe bārāṇasinagare brahmadatto nāma rājā ahosi.
Tadā bodhisatto satthavāhakule paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasamāsaccayena mātukucchito nikkhamitvā anupubbena vayappatto pañcahi sakaṭasatehi vaṇijjaṃ karonto vicarati.
So kadāci pubbantato aparantaṃ gacchati, kadāci aparantato pubbantaṃ.
Bārāṇasiyaṃyeva aññopi satthavāhaputto atthi bālo abyatto anupāyakusalo.
Tadā bodhisatto bārāṇasito mahagghaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ gahetvā pañca sakaṭasatāni pūretvā gamanasajjāni katvā ṭhapesi.
Sopi bālasatthavāhaputto tatheva pañca sakaṭasatāni pūretvā gamanasajjāni katvā ṭhapesi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Tadā bodhisatto cintesi “sace ayaṃ bālasatthavāhaputto mayā saddhiṃyeva gamissati, sakaṭasahasse ekato maggaṃ gacchante maggopi nappahossati, manussānaṃ dārudakādīnipi, balibaddānaṃ tiṇānipi dullabhāni bhavissanti, etena vā mayā vā purato gantuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti.
So taṃ pakkosāpetvā etamatthaṃ ārocetvā “dvīhipi amhehi ekato gantuṃ na sakkā, kiṃ tvaṃ purato gamissasi, udāhu pacchato”ti āha.

So cintesi “mayi purato gacchante bahū ānisaṃsā, maggena abhinneneva gamissāmi, goṇā anāmaṭṭhatiṇaṃ khādissanti, manussānaṃ anāmaṭṭhaṃ sūpeyyapaṇṇaṃ bhavissati, pasannaṃ udakaṃ bhavissati, yathāruciṃ agghaṃ ṭhapetvā bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇissāmī”ti.
Bodhisattopi pacchato gamane bahū ānisaṃse addasa.

“purato gacchantā magge visamaṭṭhānaṃ samaṃ karissanti, ahaṃ tehi gatamaggena gamissāmi, purato gatehi balibaddehi pariṇatathaddhatiṇe khādite mama goṇā puna uṭṭhitāni madhuratiṇāni khādissanti, gahitapaṇṇaṭṭhānato uṭṭhitaṃ manussānaṃ sūpeyyapaṇṇaṃ madhuraṃ bhavissati, anudake ṭhāne āvāṭaṃ khanitvā ete udakaṃ uppādessanti, tehi katesu āvāṭesu mayaṃ udakaṃ pivissāma, agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma manussānaṃ jīvitā voropanasadisaṃ, ahaṃ pacchato gantvā etehi ṭhapitagghena bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇissāmī”ti.
Atha so ettake ānisaṃse disvā “samma, tvaṃ purato gacchāhī”ti āha.
“Sādhu, sammā”ti bālasatthavāho sakaṭāni yojetvā nikkhanto anupubbena manussāvāsaṃ atikkamitvā kantāramukhaṃ pāpuṇi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Kantāraṃ nāma – corakantāraṃ, vāḷakantāraṃ, nirudakakantāraṃ, amanussakantāraṃ, appabhakkhakantāranti pañcavidhaṃ.
Yattha nhāyituṃ vā pātuṃ vā udakaṃ natthi, idaṃ nirudakakantāraṃ nāma.
Imasmiṃ pañcavidhe kantāre taṃ kantāraṃ nirudakakantārañceva amanussakantārañca.
Tasmā so bālasatthavāhaputto sakaṭesu mahantamahantā cāṭiyo ṭhapetvā udakassa pūrāpetvā saṭṭhiyojanikaṃ kantāraṃ paṭipajji.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Athassa kantāramajjhaṃ gatakāle kantāre adhivatthayakkho “imehi manussehi gahitaṃ udakaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā dubbale katvā sabbeva ne khādissāmī”ti sabbasetataruṇabalibaddayuttaṃ manoramaṃ yānakaṃ māpetvā dhanukalāpaphalakāvudhahatthehi dasahi dvādasahi amanussehi parivuto uppalakumudāni piḷandhitvā allakoso allavattho issarapuriso viya tasmiṃ yānake nisīditvā kaddamamakkhitehi cakkehi paṭipathaṃ agamāsi.

Parivāraamanussāpissa purato ca pacchato ca gacchantā allakesā allavatthā uppalakumudamālā piḷandhitvā padumapuṇḍarīkakalāpe gahetvā bhisamuḷālāni khādantā udakabindūhi ceva kalalehi ca paggharantehi agamaṃsu.
Satthavāhā ca nāma yadā dhuravāto vāyati, tadā yānake nisīditvā upaṭṭhākaparivutā rajaṃ pariharantā purato gacchanti.
Yadā pacchato vāto vāyati, tadā teneva nayena pacchato gacchanti.
Tadā pana dhuravāto ahosi, tasmā so satthavāhaputto purato agamāsi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Yakkho taṃ āgacchantaṃ disvā attano yānakaṃ maggā okkamāpetvā “kahaṃ gacchathā”ti tena saddhiṃ paṭisanthāraṃ akāsi.
Satthavāhopi attano yānakaṃ maggā okkamāpetvā sakaṭānaṃ gamanokāsaṃ datvā ekamante ṭhito taṃ yakkhaṃ avoca “bho, amhe tāva bārāṇasito āgacchāma.
Tumhe pana uppalakumudāni piḷandhitvā padumapuṇḍarīkahatthā bhisamuḷālāni khādantā kaddamamakkhitā udakabindūhi paggharantehi āgacchatha.
Kiṃ nu kho tumhehi āgatamagge devo vassati, uppalādisañchannāni vā sarāni atthī”ti pucchi.
Yakkho tassa kathaṃ sutvā “samma, kiṃ nāmetaṃ kathesi.

Tato paṭṭhāya sakalaṃ araññaṃ ekodakaṃ, nibaddhaṃ devo vassati, kandarā pūrā, tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ṭhāne padumādisañchannāni sarāni atthī”ti vatvā paṭipāṭiyā gacchantesu sakaṭesu “imāni sakaṭāni ādāya kahaṃ gacchathā”ti pucchi.
“Pacchato āgacchantaṃ sakaṭaṃ ativiya garukaṃ hutvā āgacchati, etasmiṃ kiṃ bhaṇḍa”nti?
“Parato tāva udakaṃ ānentehi vo manāpaṃ kataṃ, ito paṭṭhāya pana udakena kiccaṃ natthi, purato bahu udakaṃ, cāṭiyo bhinditvā udakaṃ chaḍḍetvā sukhena gacchathā”ti āha.
Evañca pana vatvā “tumhe gacchatha, amhākaṃ papañco hotī”ti thokaṃ gantvā tesaṃ adassanaṃ patvā attano yakkhanagarameva agamāsi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Sopi bālasatthavāho attano bālatāya yakkhassa vacanaṃ gahetvā cāṭiyo bhindāpetvā pasatamattampi udakaṃ anavasesetvā sabbaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā sakaṭāni pājāpesi, purato appamattakampi udakaṃ nāhosi, manussā pānīyaṃ alabhantā kilamiṃsu.
Te yāva sūriyatthaṅgamanā gantvā sakaṭāni mocetvā parivaṭṭakena ṭhapetvā goṇe cakkesu bandhiṃsu.
Neva goṇānaṃ udakaṃ ahosi, na manussānaṃ yāgubhattaṃ vā.
Rattibhāgasamanantare yakkhā yakkhanagarato āgantvā sabbepi goṇe ca manusse ca jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpetvā maṃsaṃ khāditvā aṭṭhīni avasesetvā agamaṃsu.
Evamekaṃ bālasatthavāhaputtaṃ nissāya sabbepi te vināsaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu, hatthaṭṭhikādīni disāvidisāsu vippakiṇṇāni ahesuṃ.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Bodhisattopi kho bālasatthavāhaputtassa nikkhantadivasato māsaḍḍhamāsaṃ vītināmetvā pañcahi sakaṭasatehi nagarā nikkhamma anupubbena kantāramukhaṃ pāpuṇi.

So tattha udakacāṭiyo pūretvā bahuṃ udakaṃ ādāya khandhāvāre bheriṃ carāpetvā manusse sannipātetvā evamāha “tumhe maṃ anāpucchitvā pasatamattampi udakaṃ mā vaḷañjayittha, kantāre visarukkhā nāma honti, pattaṃ vā pupphaṃ vā phalaṃ vā tumhehi pure akhāditapubbaṃ maṃ anāpucchitvā mā khāditthā”ti.
Evaṃ manussānaṃ ovādaṃ datvā pañcahi sakaṭasatehi kantāraṃ paṭipajji.
Tasmiṃ kantāramajjhaṃ sampatte so yakkho purimanayeneva bodhisattassa paṭipathe attānaṃ dassesi.

Bodhisatto taṃ disvāva aññāsi “imasmiṃ kantāre udakaṃ natthi, nirudakakantāro nāmesa, ayañca nibbhayo rattanetto, chāyāpissa na paññāyati, nissaṃsayaṃ iminā purato gato bālasatthavāhaputto sabbaṃ udakaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā kilametvā sapariso khādito bhavissati, mayhaṃ pana paṇḍitabhāvaṃ upāyakosallaṃ na jānāti maññe”ti.

Tato naṃ āha “gacchatha tumhe, mayaṃ vāṇijā nāma aññaṃ udakaṃ adisvā gahitaudakaṃ na chaḍḍema, diṭṭhaṭṭhāne pana chaḍḍetvā sakaṭāni sallahukāni katvā gamissāmā”ti yakkho thokaṃ gantvā adassanaṃ upagamma attano yakkhanagarameva gato.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Yakkhe pana gate manussā bodhisattaṃ āhaṃsu “ayya, ete manussā ‘esā nīlavanarāji paññāyati, tato paṭṭhāya nibaddhaṃ devo vassatī’ti vatvā uppalakumudamālādhārino padumapuṇḍarīkakalāpe ādāya bhisamuḷālāni khādantā allavatthā allakesā udakabindūhi paggharantehi āgatā, udakaṃ chaḍḍetvā sallahukehi sakaṭehi khippaṃ gacchāmā”ti.
Bodhisatto tesaṃ kathaṃ sutvā sakaṭāni ṭhapāpetvā sabbe manusse sannipātāpetvā “tumhehi ‘imasmiṃ kantāre saro vā pokkharaṇī vā atthī’ti kassaci sutapubba”nti pucchi.
Nirudakakantāro nāma eso, idāni ekacce manussā “etāya nīlavanarājiyā purato devo vassatī”ti vadanti, “vuṭṭhivāto nāma kittakaṃ ṭhānaṃ vāyatī”ti?
“Kacci pana vo ekassāpi sarīraṃ vuṭṭhivāto paharatī”ti?
“Atthi pana vo kenaci ekampi meghasīsaṃ diṭṭha”nti?
“Na ete manussā, yakkhā ete, amhe udakaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā dubbale katvā khāditukāmā āgatā bhavissanti.
Addhā so etehi udakaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā kilametvā khādito bhavissati, pañca sakaṭasatāni yathāpūritāneva ṭhitāni bhavissanti.
Ajja mayaṃ tāni passissāma, pasatamattampi udakaṃ achaḍḍetvā sīghasīghaṃ pājethā”ti pājāpesi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: So gacchanto yathāpūritāneva pañca sakaṭasatāni goṇamanussānañca hatthaṭṭhikādīni disāvidisāsu vippakiṇṇāni disvā sakaṭāni mocāpetvā sakaṭaparivaṭṭakena khandhāvāraṃ bandhāpetvā kālasseva manusse ca goṇe ca sāyamāsabhattaṃ bhojāpetvā manussānaṃ majjhe goṇe nipajjāpetvā sayaṃ balanāyako hutvā khaggahattho tiyāmarattiṃ ārakkhaṃ gahetvā ṭhitakova aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpesi.

Punadivase pana pātova sabbakiccāni niṭṭhāpetvā goṇe bhojetvā dubbalasakaṭāni chaḍḍāpetvā thirāni gāhāpetvā appagghaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā mahagghaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ āropāpetvā yathādhippetaṃ ṭhānaṃ gantvā diguṇatiguṇena mūlena bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇitvā sabbaṃ parisaṃ ādāya puna attano nagarameva agamāsi.

before.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Satthā imaṃ dhammakathaṃ kathetvā “evaṃ, gahapati, pubbe takkaggāhagāhino mahāvināsaṃ pattā, apaṇṇakaggāhagāhino pana amanussānaṃ hatthato muccitvā sotthinā icchitaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā puna sakaṭṭhānameva paccāgamiṃsū”ti vatvā dvepi vatthūni ghaṭetvā imissā apaṇṇakadhammadesanāya abhisambuddho hutvā imaṃ gāthamāha – 1.

after.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Iti bhagavā tesaṃ upāsakānaṃ tisso kulasampattiyo ca cha kāmasagge brahmalokasampattiyo ca datvāpi pariyosāne arahattamaggaphaladāyikā apaṇṇakapaṭipadā nāma, catūsu apāyesu pañcasu ca nīcakulesu nibbattidāyikā sapaṇṇakapaṭipadā nāmāti imaṃ apaṇṇakadhammadesanaṃ dassetvā uttari cattāri saccāni soḷasahi ākārehi pakāsesi.
Catusaccapariyosāne sabbepi te pañcasatā upāsakā sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahiṃsu.

after.title: [1] 1. Apaṇṇakajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Satthā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ āharitvā dassetvā dve vatthūni kathetvā anusandhiṃ ghaṭetvā jātakaṃ samodhānetvā dassesi –
“tasmiṃ samaye bālasatthavāhaputto devadatto ahosi, tassa parisā devadattaparisāva, paṇḍitasatthavāhaputtaparisā buddhaparisā, paṇḍitasatthavāhaputto pana ahameva ahosi”nti desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Akilāsunoti imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharanto kathesi.

Tathāgate kira sāvatthiyaṃ viharante eko sāvatthivāsī kulaputto jetavanaṃ gantvā satthu santike dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pasannacitto kāmesu ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajitvā upasampadāya pañcavassiko hutvā dve mātikā uggaṇhitvā vipassanācāraṃ sikkhitvā satthu santike attano cittaruciyaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā ekaṃ araññaṃ pavisitvā vassaṃ upagantvā temāsaṃ vāyamantopi obhāsamattaṃ vā nimittamattaṃ vā uppādetuṃ nāsakkhi.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Athassa etadahosi “satthārā cattāro puggalā kathitā, tesu mayā padaparamena bhavitabbaṃ, natthi maññe mayhaṃ imasmiṃ attabhāve maggo vā phalaṃ vā, kiṃ karissāmi araññavāsena, satthu santikaṃ gantvā rūpasobhaggappattaṃ buddhasarīraṃ olokento madhuraṃ dhammadesanaṃ suṇanto viharissāmī”ti puna jetavanameva paccāgamāsi.

“āvuso, tvaṃ satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā ‘samaṇadhammaṃ karissāmī’ti gato, idāni pana āgantvā saṅgaṇikāya abhiramamāno carasi, kiṃ nu kho te pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pattaṃ, appaṭisandhiko jātosī”ti?
Āvuso, ahaṃ maggaṃ vā phalaṃ vā alabhitvā “abhabbapuggalena mayā bhavitabba”nti vīriyaṃ ossajitvā āgatomhīti.
“Akāraṇaṃ te, āvuso, kataṃ daḷhavīriyassa satthu sāsane pabbajitvā vīriyaṃ ossajantena, ayuttaṃ te kataṃ, ehi tathāgatassa dassemā”ti taṃ ādāya satthu santikaṃ agamaṃsu.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Satthā taṃ disvā evamāha “bhikkhave, tumhe etaṃ bhikkhuṃ anicchamānaṃ ādāya āgatā, kiṃ kataṃ iminā”ti?
“Bhante, ayaṃ bhikkhu evarūpe niyyānikasāsane pabbajitvā samaṇadhammaṃ karonto vīriyaṃ ossajitvā āgato”ti āhaṃsu.
Atha naṃ satthā āha “saccaṃ kira tayā bhikkhu vīriyaṃ ossaṭṭha”nti?
“Kiṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu evarūpe mama sāsane pabbajitvā ‘appiccho’ti vā ‘santuṭṭho’ti vā ‘pavivitto’ti vā ‘āraddhavīriyo’ti vā evaṃ attānaṃ ajānāpetvā ‘ossaṭṭhavīriyo bhikkhū’ti jānāpesi.
Nanu tvaṃ pubbe vīriyavā ahosi, tayā ekena kataṃ vīriyaṃ nissāya marukantāre pañcasu sakaṭasatesu manussā ca goṇā ca pānīyaṃ labhitvā sukhitā jātā, idāni kasmā vīriyaṃ ossajasī”ti.
So bhikkhu ettakena vacanena upatthambhito ahosi.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Taṃ pana kathaṃ sutvā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ yāciṃsu –

“bhante, idāni iminā bhikkhunā vīriyassa ossaṭṭhabhāvo amhākaṃ pākaṭo, pubbe panassa ekassa vīriyaṃ nissāya marukantāre goṇamanussānaṃ pānīyaṃ labhitvā sukhitabhāvo paṭicchanno, tumhākaṃ sabbaññutaññāṇasseva pākaṭo, amhākampetaṃ kāraṇaṃ kathethā”ti.
“Tena hi, bhikkhave, suṇāthā”ti bhagavā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ satuppādaṃ janetvā bhavantarena paṭicchannakāraṇaṃ pākaṭamakāsi.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Atīte kāsiraṭṭhe bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto satthavāhakule paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā vayappatto pañcahi sakaṭasatehi vaṇijjaṃ karonto vicarati.
Tasmiṃ kantāre sukhumavālukā muṭṭhinā gahitā hatthe na tiṭṭhati, sūriyuggamanato paṭṭhāya aṅgārarāsi viya uṇhā hoti, na sakkā akkamituṃ.

Tasmā taṃ paṭipajjantā dārudakatilataṇḍulādīni sakaṭehi ādāya rattimeva gantvā aruṇuggamane sakaṭāni parivaṭṭaṃ katvā matthake maṇḍapaṃ kāretvā kālasseva āhārakiccaṃ niṭṭhāpetvā chāyāya nisinnā divasaṃ khepetvā atthaṅgate sūriye sāyamāsaṃ bhuñjitvā bhūmiyā sītalāya jātāya sakaṭāni yojetvā gacchanti, samuddagamanasadisameva gamanaṃ hoti.
Thalaniyāmako nāma laddhuṃ vaṭṭati, so tārakasaññā satthaṃ tāreti.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Sopi satthavāho tasmiṃ kāle imināva niyāmena taṃ kantāraṃ gacchanto ekūnasaṭṭhi yojanāni gantvā “idāni ekaratteneva marukantārā nikkhamanaṃ bhavissatī”ti sāyamāsaṃ bhuñjitvā sabbaṃ dārudakaṃ khepetvā sakaṭāni yojetvā pāyāsi.
Niyāmako pana purimasakaṭe āsanaṃ pattharāpetvā ākāse tārakaṃ olokento “ito pājetha, ito pājethā”ti vadamāno nipajji.
So dīghamaddhānaṃ aniddāyanabhāvena kilanto niddaṃ okkami, goṇe nivattitvā āgatamaggameva gaṇhante na aññāsi.
Niyāmako aruṇuggamanavelāya pabuddho nakkhattaṃ oloketvā “sakaṭāni nivattetha nivattethā”ti āha.
Sakaṭāni nivattetvā paṭipāṭiṃ karontānaññeva aruṇo uggato.

Manussā “hiyyo amhākaṃ niviṭṭhakhandhāvāraṭṭhānamevetaṃ, dārudakampi no khīṇaṃ, idāni naṭṭhamhā”ti sakaṭāni mocetvā parivaṭṭakena ṭhapetvā matthake maṇḍapaṃ katvā attano attano sakaṭassa heṭṭhā anusocantā nipajjiṃsu.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Bodhisatto “mayi vīriyaṃ ossajante sabbe vinassissantī”ti pāto sītalavelāyameva āhiṇḍanto ekaṃ dabbatiṇagacchaṃ disvā “imāni tiṇāni heṭṭhā udakasinehena uṭṭhitāni bhavissantī”ti cintetvā kuddālaṃ gāhāpetvā taṃ padesaṃ khaṇāpesi, te saṭṭhihatthaṭṭhānaṃ khaṇiṃsu.
Ettakaṃ ṭhānaṃ khaṇitvā paharantānaṃ kuddālo heṭṭhāpāsāṇe paṭihaññi, pahaṭamatte sabbe vīriyaṃ ossajiṃsu.
Bodhisatto pana “imassa pāsāṇassa heṭṭhā udakena bhavitabba”nti otaritvā pāsāṇe ṭhito oṇamitvā sotaṃ odahitvā saddaṃ āvajjento heṭṭhā udakassa pavattanasaddaṃ sutvā uttaritvā cūḷupaṭṭhākaṃ āha –
“tāta, tayā vīriye ossaṭṭhe sabbe vinassissāma, tvaṃ vīriyaṃ anossajanto imaṃ ayakūṭaṃ gahetvā āvāṭaṃ otaritvā etasmiṃ pāsāṇe pahāraṃ dehī”ti.
So tassa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchitvā sabbesu vīriyaṃ ossajitvā ṭhitesupi vīriyaṃ anossajanto otaritvā pāsāṇe pahāraṃ adāsi.
Pāsāṇo majjhe bhijjitvā heṭṭhā patitvā sotaṃ sannirumbhitvā aṭṭhāsi, tālakkhandhappamāṇā udakavaṭṭi uggañchi.
Sabbe pānīyaṃ pivitvā nhāyiṃsu, atirekāni akkhayugādīni phāletvā yāgubhattaṃ pacitvā bhuñjitvā goṇe ca bhojetvā sūriye atthaṅgate udakāvāṭasamīpe dhajaṃ bandhitvā icchitaṭṭhānaṃ agamaṃsu.
Te tattha bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇitvā diguṇaṃ tiguṇaṃ catugguṇaṃ lābhaṃ labhitvā attano vasanaṭṭhānameva agamaṃsu.
Te tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yathākammaṃ gatā, bodhisattopi dānādīni puññāni katvā yathākammameva gato.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Sammāsambuddho imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ kathetvā abhisambuddhova imaṃ gāthaṃ kathesi – 2.

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: “Akilāsuno vaṇṇupathe khaṇantā, udaṅgaṇe tattha papaṃ avinduṃ;

after.title: [2] 2. Vaṇṇupathajātakavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ munī vīriyabalūpapanno, akilāsu vinde hadayassa santi”nti.
tiṇṇannampi nidānānaṃ vitthārakathā kathīyamānā atipapañco siyāti tesaṃ tiṇṇannampītiādimāha.
kaṃ pana ārabbhāti kaṃ pana puggalaṃ ārabbha ayaṃ kathā samuṭṭhitāti ayaṃ pucchāti sambandho.
seṭṭhissa sahāyake pañcasate titthiyasāvake ārabbha ayaṃ kathā samuṭṭhitāti sambandho.
cha nisajjadoseti atidūraṃ accāsannaṃ uparivātaṃ unnatappadesaṃ atisammukhaṃ atipacchāti ete cha nisajjadose.
vuttañcetaṃ “atidūramaccāsannaṃ uparivātamunnatappadesañca atisammukhaṃ atipacchā nisajjadosā cha me vuttā”ti.
atidūre hi nisinno sace kathetukāmo hoti.
bahūsu rāsisu ekekasmiṃ dve dve hutvāti vuttaṃ hoti.
tesa [ācariyassa kāle tesūti pāṭho bhaveyya. tasmā evaṃ saṃvaṇṇitaṃ.] nti apadānaṃ vā dvipadānaṃ vā catuppadānaṃ vā bahuppadānaṃ vā sattānaṃ.
īdisesu hi ṭhānesu aggamitisaddo sabbaliṅgasādhāraṇoti daṭṭhabbo.
sekāro panettha vācāsiliṭṭhatthaṃ āgamo hoti ākhyātato nāmato vā.
kataṃ amhe karomase [jātaka. 2. 221] tiādīsu hi ākhyātato sekārāgamo.

pabbatānīti tattha tattha isigilivepullavebhārādi ke pabbate ca mahāvanagosiṅgasālavanādīni vanāni ca veḷuvanajīvakamba vanādayo ārāme ca udenacetiyagotamakacetiyādīni rukkha cetiyāni ca te te manussā tena tena bhayena tajjitā bhayato muccitukāmā puttalābhādīni vā patthayamānā saraṇaṃ yantīti attho.
netaṃ saraṇanti etaṃ sabbampi saraṇaṃ neva khemaṃ na uttamaṃ na ca etaṃ paṭicca jātiādidhammesu sattesu ekopi jātiādito sabbadukkhā pamuccatīti attho.
yocāti idaṃ akhemaṃ anuttamañca saraṇaṃ dassetvā khemaṃ uttamaṃ saraṇaṃ dassanatthaṃ āraddhaṃ.
tassattho -- yo ca gahaṭṭho vā pabbajito vā itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddhotiādikaṃ buddhadhammasaṃghānussati kammaṭṭhānaṃ nissāya seṭṭhavasena buddhañca dhammañca saṃghañca saraṇaṃ gato.
tassapi taṃ saraṇagamanaṃ aññatitthiyavandanādīhi kuppati calati.
tassa pana acalabhāvaṃ dassetuṃ maggena āgatasaraṇameva pakāsento cattāri ariyasaccāni sammappaññāya passatīti āha.
yo hi etesaṃ saccānaṃ dassanavasena etāni saraṇaṃ gato.
so ca puggalo etaṃ saraṇaṃ paṭicca sakalasmāpi vaṭṭadukkhā pamuccati.
bahulīkatoti avatthubhedavasena abahumpi punappunaṃ āsevanato bahuṃ viya karīyatīti bahulīkato.
paṭicchannoti anekehi bhavehi paṭicchannattā aññāṇadosena apākaṭoti vuttaṃ hoti.
kāsiraṭṭheti ettha nānāsampattīhi kasanti dibbanti etthāti kāsi.
raṭṭhanti gacchanti patiṭṭhahanti nagarādayo etthāti raṭṭhaṃ.

bārāṇasīnagareti ettha vānarasīsasaṇṭhāno pāsāṇo ettha atthīti vānarasīsanti vattabbe va-kārassa ba-kārattaṃ vaṇṇavipariyāyaṃ dīghaṃ, na-kārassa ṇa-kārattaṃ, sa kārassa lopañca katvā bārāṇasīti vuttaṃ.
atha vā ādikāle dverājāno raṇanti yujjhanti etthāti bārāṇasī.
dvisaddūpapada raṇa-yujjhaneti dhātuto sapaccayavasena padasiddhi veditabbā.
ettha ca brahmadatto nāma rājāti ettha brahmadattoti nāmaṃ kāsikaraṭṭhanivāsīnaṃ vohāravasena sabbesaṃ rājūnaṃ nāmaṃ.
imañca atthaṃ cattālīsanipāte tesakuṇajātake vitthārena vaṇṇayissāma.satthavāhakuleti vāṇijakule.
agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma manussānaṃ jīvitā voropanasadisanti etthāyamadhippāyo -- loke agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma payoga bāhullavasena manussānaṃ jīvitā voropanasadisaṃ.
manussānaṃ hi jīvitā voropanaṃ aññesaṃ sattānaṃ jīvitā voropanato bahupayogena kattabbaṃ hoti.
apare pana aññe vañcetvā atirekavasena agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma adinnādānapayogo hotīti manasikatvā agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma akusalakammapathavasena manussānaṃ jīvitāvoropanasadisanti vadanti.
yadi hi akusalakammapathavasena te taṃ opammaṃ vuttaṃ siyā.
evaṃ sati agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma manussānaṃ jīvitāvoropanādisadisanti vattabbaṃ bhaveyya.
tasmā yeva pana yathāvuttatthoyeva sārato gahetabbo.
taṃ gahetvā tena taranti etthāti kantāraṃ.
aññesu pana corakantārādīsu ruḷhīvasena taṃnāmatā hoti.
kiñcāpi hi katthaci samāsataddhitakitakā byāsakāle atthavisesaṃ vadanti.
yakkhā nāma satisammosādivasena dubbaleyeva manusse yebhuyyena gahetvā khādituṃ sakkuṇantīti.
uppalādisañchannāni vā sarāni atthīti pucchīti so satthavāho tasmiṃ magge agatapubbattā imasmiṃpadese īdisāni atthīti ajānitvā pucchīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
maggassa ekasmiṃ passe ṭhatvā yakkhena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpaṃ karoti.
tena pacchato āgacchantaṃ sakaṭaṃ disvā “pacchato āgacchanta”nti ādinā pucchīti veditabbaṃ.
yakkhassa vacanaṃ gahetvāti yakkhassa vacanaṃ saddahitvāti attho.parivaṭṭakena ṭhapetvāti parimaṇḍalena samantato āvaṭṭanena vatiā kārena ṭhapetvāti attho.
chāyā pissa na paññāyatīti assa purisassa sarīrachāyāpi na paññāyatīti attho.
ettha ca bheriṃ carāpetvāti pāṭhaseso daṭṭhabbo.
dvepi vatthūnīti paccunnātītavasena dvepi vatthūni ghaṭṭetvāti sambandho.
ṭhānanti kāraṇanti saṃvaṇṇanāya yuttiṃ dassetuṃ -- kāraṇaṃ hītiādimāha.ṭhānasaddassa kāraṇavācake sādhakaṃ dassetumāha -- ṭhānañcātiādi.
idāni apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ pabhedato vitthāretvā dassetumāha -- “pabhedato panā”tiādi.
cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvāti yathā nāma usunā vedhe siddhepi dhanunā vijjhatīti voharīyati.
evaṃ cakkhuviññāṇena rūpadassane siddhepi cakkhunā passatīti voharīyati.
soḷasahi ākārehīti dukkhassa pīḷanattho saṅkhataṭṭho santāpaṭṭho vipariṇāmaṭṭho.
maggassa niyyanaṭṭho hetuṭṭho dassanaṭṭho ādhipateyyaṭṭhoti etehi soḷasahi ākārehi.
tesu ca catunnaṃ saccānaṃ ādimhi pīḷanaṭṭhādayo attano sabhāvena bhavanti.
dukkhassa saṅkhataṭṭho pana samudayasaccaṃ upanidhāya upalabbhati.
samudayassa hi āyūhanalakkhaṇadassaneneva āyūhitabbassa dukkhassa saṅkhataṭṭho pākaṭo.
upadahanassa aggino pajjalanalakkhaṇadassaneneva upadahitabbassa kaṭṭhassa indhanalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
maggassa hi kilesehi upasamalakkhaṇadassaneneva dukkhassa santāpaṭṭho pākaṭo.
āyasmato nandattherassa devacchararūpadassanena sundariyā virūpalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
nirodhassa hi avipariṇāmalakkhaṇadassaneneva dukkhassa vipariṇāmaṭṭho pākaṭo.
dukkhassa hi santāpalakkhaṇadassaneneva samudayassa nidānaṭṭho pākaṭo.
asappāyaütubhojanādipaṭisevanena uṭṭhitassa rogassa dassanena utubhojanādīnaṃ rogassa nidānalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
samudayassa yeva saṃyogaṭṭho nirodhasaccaṃ upanidhāya upalabbhati.
nirodhassa hi asaṃyogalakkhaṇadassaneneva samudayassa saṃyogaṭṭho pākaṭo.yathākāmaṃ avacarituṃ samatthassa sakuṇassa dassaneneva atathābhūtassa sakuṇassa nesādassa vākare bandhanabhāvalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
samudayassa yeva palibodhaṭṭho maggasaccaṃ upanidhāya upalabbhati.
maggassa hi niyyānalakkhaṇadassaneneva samudayassa palibodhaṭṭho pākaṭo.
bhesajjassa sītalabhāvalakkhaṇadassanena attano kāye uṭṭhitassa rogassa santāpabhāvalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
samudayassa hi vaṭṭadukkhato avivekabhāvadassaneneva nirodhassa vivekaṭṭho pākaṭo.
āgārikānaṃ gihīnaṃ dukkhato avivekabhāvadassanena anāgārikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dukkhato vivekabhāvalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
nirodhassayeva asaṅkhataṭṭho pana maggasaccaṃ upanidhāya upalabbhati.
nirodhassa hi maggasaṅkhātānavajjahetudassaneneva taṇhāsaṅkhātasāvajjahetuvirahitā saṅkhataṭṭho pākaṭo.
sukhedhitassa samiddhassa pituno uccaṅge kīḷantassa kumārassa pitudassanena nāyaṃ dāsiyā putto.
api ca imassa seṭṭhino puttoti viññāṇalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
athavā anamatagge saṃsāre kudācanaṃ supinenapi adiṭṭhapubbo maggo.
so ca kammacittaütuāhārehi uppajjanato saṅkhatoyeva nāma.
nibbānaṃ pana tādisaṃ na hoti paccayavirahito hotīti evaṃ nirodhassa asaṅkhataṭṭho pākaṭo.
eko puriso bhujissopi samāno paresaṃ gehe nivāsanavasena parāyatto hoti.
eko pana puriso bhujisso ca hoti paresaṃ gehe anivāsanavasena aparāyatto ca hoti.
tesu paresaṃ gehe nisinnassa purisassa dassanena paresaṃ gehe anisinnassa purisassa aparāyattatālakkhaṇaṃ viya.
nirodhassayeva amataṭṭho pana dukkhasaccaṃ upanidhāya upalabbhati.
dukkhassa hi matabhāvadassanena nirodhassa amataṭṭho pākaṭo.
gilānassa ātura bhāvadassanena vekallassa anāturabhāvalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
samudayasaccaṃ hi hetubhā vena uppajjamānampi dukkhassa yeva hetu hoti.
maggasaccaṃ pana nirodhassa hetu hotīti evaṃ viññāyati.
dvīsu rañño santakesu yānesu ekassa aṭṭhapitarājāsanabhāvadassanena na yidaṃ rājāruḷhayānaṃ.
itaraṃ pana ṭhapitarājāsanayānaṃ idaṃ yeva rājāruḷhayānanti yānabhāvena sadisassa aññassa dassanena viññātalakkhaṇaṃ viya.
maggassa hi ārammaṇabhūtassa nirodhassa dassaneneva tadārammaṇamaggassa dassanaṭṭho pākaṭo.
suvaṇṇamayassa nerupabbatassa dassanena diṭṭhaṃ nerupabbataṃ paṭicca passantassa nesādassa cakkhuviññāṇassa dassanasattilakkhaṇaṃ viya.
dukkhassa hi pīḷanabhāvadassaneneva maggassa ādhipateyyaṭṭho pākaṭo.
kapaṇassa dukkhabhāvadassanena seṭṭhino samiddhabhāvadassanaṃ viyāti evaṃ soḷasahi ākārehi cattāri saccāni pakāsetīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
so ayantiādinā atītapaccuppannavasena dve vatthuni ghaṭṭayitvāti attho.
ettha hi atītavatthunā saddhiṃ paccuppannavatthuno saṃghaṭṭanameva samodhānaṃ nāma.
samā odhaṃ saṃkhīpanaṃ ānetvāti pana padacchedo daṭṭhabboti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathā
lines: yo yena yaṃ varaṃ neti. jino sutena uttamaṃ.
taṃ taṃ taṃ abhivanditvā. sirasā ādaraṃ ahaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathā
lines: kāmañcāpi katā atthi. porāṇehi ca yā ṭīkā.

before.title: ganthārambhakathā
lines: yasmā tasmāva tosetvā. yā katā viññūnaṃ manaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: saṃvaṇṇanārambhe ratanattayaṃ namassitukāmo tassa visiṭṭhaguṇayogasandassanatthaṃ “jātikoṭisahassehī”ti ādimāha.
vandanārahe ca katā vandanā yathādhippetamatthaṃ sādheti.
ettha ca saṃvaṇṇanārambhe ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇappayojanaṃ tattha tattha bahudhā papañcayanti ācariyā.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: taṃ sammadeva tesaṃ uggahaṇadhāraṇādikkamaladdhabbāya sammāpaṭipattiyā sabbahitasukhanipphādanatthaṃ.
atha vā maṅgalabhāvato, sabbakiriyāsu pubbakiccabhāvato, paṇḍitehi samācaritabhāvato, āyatiṃ paresaṃ diṭṭhānugatiāpajjanato ca saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ ratanattayapaṇāmakiriyā”ti. [sāratthaṭī. 1. 2.]

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tasmā saṃvaṇṇanārambhe ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇaṃ yathāpaṭiññātasaṃvaṇṇanāya anantarāyena parisamāpanatthanti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇena cettha yathāpaṭiññātasaṃvaṇṇanāya anantarāyena parisamāpanaṃ ratanattayapūūjāya paññāpāṭavabhāvato, tāya paññāpāṭavañca rāgādimalavidhamanato.
vuttaṃ hetaṃ -- “yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati.
nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hotī”ti ādi. tasmā ratanattayapūjanena vikkhālitamalāya paññāya pāṭavasiddhi.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: vuttaṃ hi tassa samādhihetuttaṃ -- “ujugatacitto kho mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: samādhissa ca paññāya padaṭṭhānabhāvo vuttoyeva “samāhito bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtaṃ pajānātī”ti. [saṃ. 2. 12.] tato evaṃ paṭubhūtāya paññāya paṭiññāmahattakataṃ khedamabhibhuyya anantarāyena saṃvaṇṇanaṃ samāpayissati.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: atha vā ratanattayapūjāya āyuvaṇṇasukhabalavaḍḍhanato anantarāyena parisamāpanaṃ veditabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti. āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ bala”nti. [dhammapada. 29.]

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tato āyuvaṇṇasukhabalavuḍḍhiyā hoteva kāriyaniṭṭhānamiti vuttaṃ “anantarāyena parisamāpanattha''nti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: “satti me bhante dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti.
satthugāravatā dhammagāravatā saṃghagāravatā sikkhāgāravatā samādhigāravatā sovacassatā kalyāṇamittatā “ti. [aṃ. 3. 420.]

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ratanattayapūjā hi niratisayapuññakkhettasaṃbuddhiyā aparimeyyappabhavo puññātisayoti bahuvidhantarāyepi lokasannivāse antarāyanibandhanasakalasaṃkilesaviddhaṃ sanāya pahoti.
tasmā suvuttaṃ “saṃvaṇṇanā rambhe ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇaṃ yathāpaṭiññātasaṃvaṇṇanāya anantarāyena parisamāpanatthanti veditabba”nti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ pana sappayojanaṃ ratanattayavandanaṃ kattukāmo paṭhamaṃ tāva bhagavato vandanaṃ kātuṃ tammūlakattā sesaratanānaṃ.
tattha ca jātaka saṃvaṇṇanābhāvato pubbacaritaguṇagaṇena thomento āha “jāti koṭisahassehī”ti ādi.
ettha ca yassā desanāya saṃvaṇṇanaṃ kattukāmo.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: “jātikoṭisahassehī”ti ādinā pana bhagavā karuṇāpaññā dhammehi thomito.
ettha siyā -- nanu bhagavato asaṅkhyeyyaguṇato asaṅkhyeyyanāmāni santi.
atha kasmā ettakeneva guṇadvayena bhagavato thomanā katā.
yathā ca nāma anekakoṭivibhavassa seṭṭhino anekesu kahāpaṇesu santesu kahāpaṇadvayena dhanavāti thomanā katā.
evameva guṇavato sammāsambuddhassa ettakeneva karuṇāpaññā dvayena thomitattā appaguṇatāyeva paññāyatīti?
karuṇāpaññāgahaṇena hi aparimeyyappabhāvā sabbepi buddhaguṇā saṅgahitāti daṭṭhabbā.
aññathā ko nāma puggalo samattho bhagavato guṇe anupadaṃ niravasesato dassetuṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: teneva ca āyasmatā sāriputtattherenapi buddhaguṇaparicchedanaṃ patianuyuttena “no hetaṃ bhante”ti paṭikkhipitvā “api ca me bhante dhammanvayo vidito”ti vuttaṃ. [dī. 3. 83.] tasmā “jātikoṭisahassehī”ti ādinā karuṇāpaññāmukhena saṅkhepato sakalasabbaññuguṇehi bhagavantaṃ abhitthavīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: koṭisaddo pana “kappakoṭīhi”tiādīsu [vi. ṭṭha. 1. 1.] lakkhe satasaha—sse vattati.
idha pana lakkhe satasahasse yeva vattati.
jātīnaṃ koṭi, jātiyo—yeva vā koṭi jātikoṭi.
jātikoṭīnaṃ sahassāni, jātikoṭi—yoyeva vā sahassāni jātikoṭisahassāni.
pamāṇena rahitaṃ pariccattaṃ apetaṃ vāti pamāṇarahitaṃ.
dānasīlādipāramitāvasena vā dānapiyavacanādisaṅgahavatthūhi vā annapānādidānavatthūhi vā dānasīlādipuññakiriyavatthūhi vā aṅgapaccaṅgādi pariccāgavasena vā taṃ taṃ hitanti vuttaṃ hoti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: cutipaṭisandhivasena paricchinne ekasmiṃ bhave kataṃ sabbaṃ hitaṃ tasmiṃ bhave pakkhipitvā ekahitanti niyamena saṅgahetvā jātikoṭisahassanti vā jātikoṭidasasahassanti vā jātikoṭisatasahassanti vā saṃpuṇṇaṃ katvā ekaṃ dve ti ādinā kamena hitassa aparicchinnatā vuttā hoti “jātikoṭisahassehi pamāṇarahitaṃ hita”nti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: atha vā jātiyā aparicchinnakālaṃ jātīti gahite pamāṇarahitanti kāloyeva gahetabbo.
accantasaṃyoge upayogavacanassa sambhavato jātikoṭi sahassakālenāpi aparicchinnakālanti vuttaṃ hoti.
yathā ca byādhighātaṃ osadhaṃ rogīnaṃ hitanti vuccati.
yathā ca rudhiramaṃsādidhātuvaḍḍhanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ kisassa hitanti vuccati.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ettha ca dukkhāpanayanampi veneyyajanaparipācanampi bodhisambhārapūraṇampi sabbampetaṃ hitameva parahitabhāvato.
anumānato subhāsubhakammaṃ paccakkhato iṭṭhāniṭṭhavipākañca sabbasattesu lokiyatīti katvā sattasamūho lokoti vuccati.
anumānapaccakkhato kammavipākaṃ paricchinditvā hitesu sattānaṃ pavattanaṃ dassetuṃ lokasaddena sattā niddiṭṭhāti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: jātivasena jāyitvā jarāya jiyyitvā carante sabbasatte karuṇāya hitānayanaṃ akāsi bhagavāti vuttaṃ hoti.
hitasaddayoge sampadānavacanassa sambhavato tassa lokassāti vibhatyantavasena padaṃ yojetabbaṃ.

tathā hi sabbānattha parihārapubbaṅgamāya niravasesahitasukhavidhānatapparāya niratisayāya payogasampattiyā sadevamanussāya pajāya accantupakāritāya aparimita nirupamappabhāvaguṇavisesasamaṅgitāya ca sabbasattuttamo bhagavā aparimāṇāsu lokadhātūsu aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ ekapaṭisaraṇo patiṭṭhā.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: veneyyānaṃ hitasukhaṃ mettāyana vasena āsīsati patthetīti attho.
atha vā nāthati veneyyagate kilese upatāpetīti attho.
bhagavā hi “sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī”ti [aṃ. 3. 9.] ādinā sattānaṃ taṃ taṃ hitapaṭipattiṃ yācitvāpi karuṇāya samussāhito te tattha niyojeti.
paramena vā cittissariyena sampannāgato sabbasatte īsati abhibhavatīti paramissaro bhagavā “nātho''ti vuccati.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: mahesināti mahante sīlasamādhipaññāvimuttivimuttiñāṇadassana saṅkhāte pañca dhammakkhandhe esati gavesati sīlenāti mahesi.
katanti tapaccayassa kammavācakattā tena mahesināti katvatthe karaṇavacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
yena lokanāthena mahesinā jātikoṭisahassehi lokassa pamāṇarahitaṃ hitaṃ kataṃ.
yenāti pana pubbe vuttassa atthassa katanti niyametvā nidassanato niyamavacananti vattabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: namassitvāti ettha vinā paccuppannapariyāyabhūtakriyāya anuppajjanato namāmīti namassitvā, anaminti vā namassitvāti kāladvayena vikappadvayaṃ icchitabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ karuṇāpaññāmukhena saṅkhepato sakalasabbaññuguṇehi bhagavantaṃ thometvā idāni dhammaṃ thometuṃ “katvā”ti ādimāha.
dhammassāti yathānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjamāne catūsu apāyesu apatamāne dhāretīti dhammo.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: saṃsāradukkhe vā apatamāne katvā dhāretīti dhammo.
evañca katvā ariyamaggo tassa tadatthasiddhihetutāya nibbānañcāti ubhayameva nippariyāyato dhāreti.
ariyaphalaṃ pana taṃsamucchinnakilesapaṭippassambhanena tadanuguṇatāya, pariyattidhammo tadadhigamahetutāyāti ubhayaṃ pariyāyato dhāretīti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: añjaliṃ katvāti padassa namosaddādīsu antogadhato taṃ yogassa ca sampadānatthasambhavato tassa dhammassāti sampadānavacanaṃ icchitabbaṃ.
so “suṇātu me bhante saṃgho”ti ādīsu āgato.
idha pana paramatthasaṃghasaṅkhāto dakkhiṇeyyasaṃgho yeva adhippetoti vadanti.
vuttaṃ hi tattha “pothujjanikasaṃghassāpi pubbabhāgappaṭipadāya ṭhitattā purimacetanāya viya dāne ettheva saṅgaho daṭṭhabbo.
sopi hi kiñcāpi ariyena diṭṭhisīlasāmaññena asaṃhato.
niyyānikapakkhiyena pana pothujjanikena saṃhatattā dakkhiṇeyyapaṇipātāraho saṃgho yevā”ti. taṃ yuttaṃ, kalyāṇaputhujjanassāpi sekkhasaṅgahato.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tassa ca pāde namassitvā dhammassa ca añjaliṃ katvā saṃghañca patimānetvāti attho.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ gāthāttayena saṅkhepato sakalaguṇasaṃkittanamukhena ratanattayassa paṇāmaṃ katvā idāni taṃ nipaccakāraṃ yathādhippete payojane pariṇāmento āha “namassanādino”ccādi.
ratanattaye pavattassa namassanādino assa puññassa ānubhāvena sabbe upaddave chetvāti sambandho.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tesaṃ hi “itipi so bhagavā”ti ādinā yathābhūtaguṇe āvajjentassa amatādhigamahetubhūtaṃ anappakaṃ pītipāmojjaṃ uppajjati.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

pamuditassa pīti jāyatī”ti ādi. [aṃ. 2. 252.] cittīkatādibhāvo vā ratanaṭṭho.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ayaṃ panettha sambandho -- “ratanattaye pavattassa namassanādino assa puññassa ānubhāvena sabbe upaddave chetvā bhāsissa”nti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ ratanattayassa nipaccakārakaraṇe payojanaṃ dassetvā idāni yassa jātakassa atthaṃ saṃvaṇṇetukāmo.
tassa pavattākāraṃ dassetuṃ “taṃ taṃ kāraṇa”nti ādimāha.
tattha taṃ taṃ kāraṇanti sīlapaññādiṃ taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ.
taṃ taṃ uppattiṃ vā āgamma paṭicca.
īdisesu hi niyamavirahito aniyamasaddo icchitabboti vadanti.
atha vā yesu jātakesu satthā nāyako uppajjati.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: atha vā lokato nittharaṇena maggaphalañāṇena atthikoti attho.
bhagavā hi dānādino ekekassapi paricchedaṃ atikkamitvā pāramiyo paripūrīti.
bodhisaddo cettha maggañāṇādīsu anekesu atthesu pavattati.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: “magga phale ca nibbāne. rukkhe paññattiyaṃ tathā.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ayaṃ panettha yojanā “taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ āgamma jutimatā mahesinā apaṇṇakādīni yāni purā jātakāni desitāni.
yesu ciraṃ satthā nāyako lokanittharaṇatthiko anante bodhisambhāre paripācesi.
tāni sabbāni ekajjhaṃ saṅgahaṃ āropentehi dhammasaṅgāhakehi yaṃ jātakaṃ nāma saṅgīta”nti.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: saṅgahanti ettha ca saṅgaho nāma visuṃ visuṃ vippakiṇṇānaṃ ekattho pasaṃharaṇaṃ.
jātakaṃ nāmāti jātaṃ bhūtaṃ atītaṃ bhagavato cariyaṃ.
aññatra pana jātaṃ eva jātakanti gahetabbaṃ.
tathā hi jātakasaddo desanāyampi vattati “itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ”tiādīsu.
saṅgītanti ekakādivasena rāsikaraṇavasena vā samodhānetvā kathitanti attho.
tenettha yo buddhavaṃso saṅgītoti attho daṭṭhabbo.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: idāni abhiyācakānaṃ nāmehi saddhiṃ abhiyācanākāraṃ dassetuṃ “buddhavaṃsassā”ti ādimāha.
aṭṭhadassināti diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikavasena duvidhaṃ atthaṃ passati sīlenā- ti atthena ttha-kārassa ṭṭha-kāraṃ katvā evaṃnāmakena therena yācitoti sambandho.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: idaṃ hi “sadā suddhavihārinā”ti etassa hetudīpakaṃ visesanapadaṃ.

buddhamittenāti buddhassa mitto orasabhāvenāti atthena evaṃ nāmakena therenāti attho.
santacittenāti vigatuddhaccādimalabhāvena santacittena viññunā asaṃsaṭṭhavihārena sadā suddhavihārinā buddhamittena tatheva abhigantvā yācitoti sambandho.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: idāni aññampi abhiyācakaṃ dassetuṃ “mahiṃsāsakavaṃsamhī''ti ādi māha.
ettha ca mahisaddena mahiṭṭhā gahetabbā yathā mañcasaddena mañcaṭṭhāti.
suddhabuddhināti rāgādimalehi virahato suddhā buddhi yassāti suddhabuddhi.
tatheva abhigantvā yācitoti ānetvā sambandho daṭṭhabbo.
acintiyaṃ ānubhāvaṃ vijjotayantassa tassa jātakatthassa vaṇṇananti sambandho.

before.title: ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tattha dhammarucisāgalanāmānaṃ abhayagirijetavanavāsīnaṃ vaṇṇanāya atthibhāvena visuṃ evaṃ vuttaṃ.
bhāsatoti bhāsantassa mama vacanaṃ sādhu tumhe sādhavo gaṇhantūti sambandho.
ettha ca tumheti tayogavasena vuttepi tassa atthabhūtena sādhavotināmayogapadena saha ṭhitattā taṃ apekkhitvā gaṇhantūti paṭhamapurisavacanaṃ vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: nidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: idāni yathāpaṭiññātaṃ jātakassa atthavaṇṇanaṃ kattukāmo “sā panāya”ādimāha.
evaṃ suṭṭhu viññātā bhaveyyāti tadākāraṃ dassetuṃ “dūrenidāna”nti ādimāha.
tattha dūrenidānanti dūre pavattaṃ nidānaṃ dūrenidānanti aluttavibhattivasena majjhelopasamāso daṭṭhabbo.

lines: bhaddakappatoti etthāyaṃ kappa saddo saüpasaggo anupasaggo ca vitakkavidhānapaṭibhāgapaññattikālaparamāyuvohārasamantabhāvābhisaddahanachedanaviniyogavinayakriyālesantarakappataṇhādiṭṭhiasaṅkhyeyyakappa mahākappādīsu dissati.
tathā hesa “nekkhammasaṅkappo abyāpādasaṅkappo”ti ādīsu vitakke āgato.
“ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā”ti [dī. 2. 86.] ādīsu paramāyumhi.
“anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcahi samaṇakappehi phalaṃ paribhuñjitu”ntiādīsu [vi. 4. 244.] samaṇavohāre.

lines: pāraṅgato na ca pacceti tādī”ti ādīsu [suttani. 404.] taṇhādiṭṭhīsu. tathā hi vuttaṃ niddese “kappoti uddānato dve kappā taṇhākappo diṭṭhikappo”ti. “anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe”tiādīsu [vi. 1. 5.] asaṅkhyeyyakappe. “cattārimāni bhikkhave kappassa asaṅkhyeyyānī”tiādīsu [aṃ. 1. 406.] mahākappe. idhāpi mahākappeyeva daṭṭhabbo. tatrāyaṃ padasiddhi kappīyatīti kappo. ettakāni vassāni vassasatāni vassasahassāni vassasatasahassānīti vā saṃvaccharavasena gaṇhetuṃ asakkuṇeyyattā kevalaṃ sāsaparāsiupamādīhi kappetabbo parikappetabbaparimāṇoti attho. vuttaṃ hetaṃ -- “kīvadīgho nukho bhante kappoti? dīgho kho bhikkhu kappo. so na sukaro saṅkhātuṃ 'ettakāni vassānī'ti vā 'ettakāni vassasatānī'ti vā 'ettakāni vassasahassānī'ti vā 'ettakāni vassasatasahassānī' ti vā. sakkā pana bhante upamaṃ kātunti? 'sakkā bhikkhū'ti bhagavā avoca. seyyathāpi bhikkhu yojanaṃ āyāmena yojanaṃ vitthārena yojanaṃ ubbedhena puṇṇaṃ sāsapānaṃ guḷikābaddhaṃ. tato puriso vassasata vassasahassa accayena ekamekaṃ sāsapaṃ uddhareyya. khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu mahāsāsaparāsi iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya. natveva kappo. evaṃ dīgho kho bhikkhu kappo”ti. svāyaṃ mahākappo saṃvaṭṭādivasena catuasaṅkhyeyyakappasaṅgaho. vuttampi cetaṃ --

before.title: nidānakathāvaṇṇanā

before.title: nidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tattha tayo saṃvaṭṭā tejosaṃvaṭṭo āposaṃvaṭṭo vāyo saṃvaṭṭoti.

tassa asaṅkhyeyyabhāvābhāvato ekaṃ ṭhānantaraṃ asaṅkhyeyyañcāti viruddhametaṃ.
nanu ca asaṅkhyabhāvena asaṅkhyeyyattepi tassa catubbidhabhāvo na yujjatīti?

before.title: nidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: dīpaṅkaradasabalassa ca hi koṇḍaññadasabalassa ca antare mahākappānaṃ ekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ buddhasuñño loko ahosi.
tathā bhagavato koṇḍaññassa ca bhagavato maṅgalassa ca antare.
tathā bhagavato sobhitassa ca bhagavato anomadassissa ca antare.
tathā bhagavato nāradassa ca bhagavato padumuttarassa ca antareti evaṃ gaṇanātītatāya asaṅkhyeyyattepi catūsu ṭhānesu mahākappānaṃ gaṇanātikkamena catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānanti vuttaṃ.
yasmā pana padumuttaradasabalassa ca sumedhadasabalassa ca antare tiṃsakappasahassāni.
sujātadasabalassa ca dīghadassīdasabalassa ca antare navasahassādhikāni kappānaṃ saṭṭhisahassāni dvāsītuttarāni aṭṭha ca satāni.
dhammadassīdasabalassa ca siddhatthadasabalassa ca antare vīsati kappā.
siddhatthadasabalassa ca tissadasabalassa ca antare eko kappo.
bhagavato vipassissa ca bhagavato sikhissa ca antare saṭṭhi kappā.
bhagavato ca vessabhū bhagavato ca kakusandhassa antare tiṃsa kappā.
iti padumuttara dasabalassa uppannakappato paṭṭhāya heṭṭhā tesaṃ tesaṃ buddhānaṃ uppannakappehi iminā ca bhaddakappena saddhiṃ satasahassamahākappā adhikāti veditabbā.

before.title: nidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: amaro etissaṃ atthīti amaravatīti maṅgalavohāravasenetaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

kassaci hi tulyādhikaraṇapadesu bhinnaliṅgasaṅkhyābhāvopi dissati yathā “haṃsāvatiyā nagare, aṅgesu janapade, vīsatiyā ṭhānesū”ti.
sumedho nāmāti tikkhajavāditāsampannatāya sundarā medhā yassāti sumedho.
yena brāhmaṇā attanā kataṃ pāpaṃ udake pavāhanti.

brahmuno vā apaccanti brāhmaṇoti vadanti lokiyā.

lines: paṭisaddena kammappavacanīyena yogepi upa yogavacanaṃ na sambhavati avisayattā.

before.title: nidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: na hi paramatthato ekopi dhammo paralokaṃ gato nāma atthi.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: idāni yathāvuttassa atthassa āvibhavanatthāya ādito paṭṭhāya sumedhakathaṃ vitthāretumāha “imassa panatthassā”ti ādi.
evaṃ sati imasmiṃ ṭhāne vacanena kiṃ payojananti āha “sā panesā”ti ādi.
tattha sā panesāti ettha “dvīsu sabbanāmesu pubbameva padhāna”nti vacanato sā sumedhakathāti ekasseva padassa attho vattabbo.
tathāpi gāthāsambandhena āgatattā yasmā na suṭṭhu pākaṭā.
bahūnaṃ atthānaṃ byāpanicchāya dvikkhattuṃ udīraṇaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: kassa pana asaṅkhiyeti aññassa avuttattā kappassa ca vuttattā pakaraṇato kappānanti ayamattho viññāyateva.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: manoramanti samasuciparamaramaṇīyabhūmibhāgattā chāyūdakasampannattā sulabhāhārattā sabbopakaraṇayuttattā ca samiddhattā devamanussādīnaṃ mano ramayatīti manoramaṃ.
bherisaddenāti ettha kiñcāpi bherisaddo sāmaññena vāditabbassa tūriyavisesassa vācako.

hūdhātuto hi tuṃpaccayassa tavepaccayassa vā tuyeādeso, ūkārassa ca ekārādeso daṭṭhabbo.
ayaṃ panattho hi dhātuvasena na veditabbo.
so maggo hetubhāvāya na na hoti.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tividhaggi vijjanteti tividhe rāgādike aggimhi vijjamāneti attho.
nibbānanti tassa tividhassa rāgādiaggissa nibbāpanaṃ upasamanaṃ nibbānañca icchitabbaṃ.
liṅgavipariyāyena vibhattilopena ca ayaṃ niddeso daṭṭhabbo.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: amatantaḷeti amatasaṅkhātassa taḷākassāti sāmiatthe bhūmavacanavasena attho daṭṭhabbo.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: addhānamaddhā padavī. vattani ceva santatī”ti imāni nāmāni.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ettha pana keci “nāvāti ādīni pakatimaggassa nāmānī”ti vadanti.
pakatimaggassa kismiñcipi pāḷippadese “nāvā”ti ādīhi padehi vuttaṭṭhānābhāvato, abhidhānasatthesu ca “nāvā”iccādikānaṃ tadabhidhānānaṃ anāgatattā.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: na doso so tikicchaketi tikicchakassa doso natthi.
yathāpi kuṇapaṃ purisoti yathāpi maṇḍanajātiko daharo yuvā puriso ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭīyitvā harāyitvā jigucchitvā taṃ kuṇapaṃ mocetvā gaccheyya.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: atha vā ussāsiyyati ca jīyatīti ussāso.
vaccaṃ katvā yathā kuṭinti vaccaṃ katvā kuṭiṃ naranāriyo viyāti attho.
mahācorasamo viyāti cakkhuādīhi rūpādīsu piyarūpesu sārajjanādivasena pāṇātipātaadinnādānādicoro hutvā sabbaṃ kusalaṃ vilumpatīti mahācorasamo eva.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: yathā so bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya corehi saddhiṃ gacchanto puriso te core pahāya gacchati.
evamevāhampi imaṃ mahācorasamaṃ kāyaṃ pahāya attano sotthibhāvakaraṃ maggaṃ gavesituṃ gamissāmīti atthasambandho veditabbo.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: kusalacchedanabhayāti ca vattabbe chandānurakkhaṇatthāya nakārassa anto dīghavasena vutto.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ vuttesu atthesu idha pabbajjā gahetabbā.
heṭṭhā vuttanayenāti “so rañño ārocetvā nagare bheriṃ carāpetvā”ti ādinā heṭṭhā vuttanayena.
yebhuyyena bodhisattā isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā taṃ pabbataṃ upanissāya abhiññāyo nibbattetvā samaṇadhammaṃ akaṃsu.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: “evaṃ samāhite citte”ti ādinānayenāti “evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte”ti [vi. 1. 5.] evaṃ vuttehi aṭṭhahi kāraṇehi samupetaṃ abhiññāsaṅkhātaṃ balaṃ āharitunti attho.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: pavattaphalabhojanoti brahmacārīgahaṭṭhavanapatthaparibbājakasaṅkhātesu catūsu assamesu vanapatthabhāvena vane vasitvā attano ṭhānapattaphalāhāro hutvāti attho.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tesu brahmaṃ mantaṃ carati sajjhāyati sīlenāti brahmacārī.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evāhaṃ cintayitvānāti evaṃ ahaṃ heṭṭhā vuttappakārena cintayitvāti attho.
nekasaddo hi anekasaddena samānattho hutvā sāsane visuṃ tiṭṭhati yathā “alābu lābū”ti.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ādīsu hi nekasaddo anupapado hutvā tiṭṭhati.
ettha ca satipi parasare samāsagatassa nakārassa anādeso na hoti tassa anādesassa aniccavidhibhāvato.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: paṇṇasālā sumāpitā”ti imāya pāḷiyā neyyatthataṃ dassetuṃ “tatthā''ti ādimāha.
“sāriputta tasmiṃ dhammikapabbate”ti idaṃ pakiṇṇakadesanāvasena bhagavatā vuttavacanaṃ gahetvā dassitaṃ.
ettha ca satipi rahādigaṇatte bahulādhikārattā anasaddassa nakārassa ṇa kārādeso na hoti.
vacanasaddapariyāye hi gahanasadde ṇakārādeso na upalabbhatīti.
caṅkamassa anto vāti caṅkamassa āyāmato ubhosu passesu ekasmiṃ vā.
pañca dosavivajjitanti ettha pañcahi nīvaraṇadosehi vivajjitanti atthaṃ gahetvā “abhiññābalamāhari”nti iminā uttarapadenāpi sambandho daṭṭhabbo.
aṭṭhaguṇasamupetanti ettha evaṃ samāhite citteti evamādinā vuttehi aṭṭhahi guṇehi sampannāgatanti atthaṃ gahetvā abhiññābalamāharīti iminā uttarapadenāpi sambandho daṭṭhabbo.
ettha ca yasmā buddhassa bhagavato dhammadesanā na tāva labbhati.
anattalakkhaṇaṃ pana buddhassa bhagavato dhammadesanaṃ nissāyeva sattānaṃ cittasantāne paññāyati.
mūlamhi pana tīhi daṇḍehi katattā tidaṇḍoti vuccati.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: sakkasaddādito parassa dinnasaddassa niccaṃ dattiyādeso hoti samāse.
keci pana sakkaṭabhāsāyaṃ kataparicayā sakkaṭabhāsāyaṃ saṃvaḍḍhā sāsanikā pāḷinayaṃ anolo ketvā “brahmadattaṃ cīvaraṃ, devadatto patto”ti saddaracanaṃ kubbiṃsu.
taṃ sāsanaṃ patvā na yujjati tādisassa guṇasaddassa sāsane abhāvato, aṭṭhakathācariyehi ca chaḍḍanato”ti.
tathā dattādeso pi samāse yeva bhavati.
dhammadinnā bhikkhūnīti evamādinā rūpadvayaṃ sijjhati sāsane.
byāsavasena pana visuṃ ṭhito guṇabhūto dattasaddo natthi.
sāsane ca byāsavasena visuṃ ṭhito dattasaddo vijjamānopi guṇabhūto na hoti paṇṇattivasena ṭhitattā.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: cirāyantīti hi nāmadhātuvasena nipphanno nipātassapi saddassa dhāturūpena siddhattā.
casaddo hi majjhe ṭhatvā uttarapadampi apekkhati.
cisaddo panettha”yaṃkiñci yatthakatthacī”ti ādīsu viya nipāto.
parapaṭibaddhatāyāti sayaṃ sukhena ca kātuṃ asakkuṇe yyatāya sāṭakassa parapaṭibaddhabhāvo.
jiṇṇassa hi tunnanti jiṇṇasāṭakassa jiṇṇaṭṭhāne puna katasūcikammaṃ.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: te hi paṭipakkhaṃ atthayantīti paccatthikāti vuccanti.
atha vā bhāvasaddaṃ apekkhitvā sāmiatthe chaṭṭhīvacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: guṇasaddo ca ānisaṃsattho “sataguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā”ti ādīsuiya.
paccatthikānaṃ nirupabhogabhāvoti paccatthikehi anicchitattā tesaṃ aparibhuñjanabhāvoti attho.
ettha ca vaṃsasaddena veḷuādayo sabbepi cīvaraṭṭhapanatthāya katā gahetabbā.
tīsu ṭhānesu vaṅkakājanti vemajjhe ubhosu ca antesu vaṅkakājaṃ ādāyāti attho.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: vivekaṃ pahāya vicarantaṃ puggalaṃ kilesapūtigandhavasena khādantīti attho.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: “ahaṃ pana navakanakakaṭakanūpurādisaṅghaṭṭanasaddasammissitamadhura hasitakathitagehajanaramaṇīyaṃ uḷāravibhavasobhitaṃ suravarabhavanākāramagāraṃ kheḷapiṇḍaṃ viya pahāya vivekārāmatāya sabbajanapāpapavāhanaṃ tapovanaṃ paviṭṭhosmi.
idha pana me paṇṇasālāya vāso dutiyo gharāvāso viya hoti.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: mānamadapurisamadanti ettha padhānaṃ padahantassa attānaṃ ukkhipitvā uppanno mado mānamado nāma.
purisabhāvaṃ paṭicca balavasena uppanno mado purisamado nāma.
pavattaphalabhojanoti ambaṭṭhasutte vuttesu aṭṭhasu tāpasesu pavattaphalabhojibhāvaṃ dasseti.
nisajjaṭṭhānacaṅkame seyyakālaṃ atikkamitvā vīriyaṃ akāsinti vuttaṃ hoti.
atha vā sattāhassa abbhantareti vibhattivipallāsavasena attho daṭṭhabbo.

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: loke udapādīti ettha saṅkhepe nevāyaṃ anupubbikathā -- ayaṃ kira dīpaṅkaro nāma mahāsatto samattiṃsapāramiyo pūretvā vessantarattabhāvasadise attabhāve ṭhito pathaviṃ kampetuṃ samatthāni mahādānāni datvā āyupariyosāne tusitapure nibbattitvā tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā dasasahassacakkavāḷadevatāhi sannipatitvā --

before.title: sumedhakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: sadevakaṃ tārayanto. bujjhassu amataṃ pada”nti. [buddhavaṃsa. 305.] vutte tato so devatānaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā ca pañca mahāvilokanāni viloketvā tato cuto rammavatīnagare attano yasavibhūtiyā vijitavāsudevassa naradevassa sudevassa nāma rañño kule sumedhāya deviyā kucchismiṃ āsāḷhipuṇṇamiyā uttarāsāḷhanakkhattena paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā mahatā parivārena parihariyamāno mahādeviyā kucchimhi maṇikūṭagato viya kenaci asucinā amakkhito dasamāse vasitvā saliladharavivaragato saradakālacando viya tassā udarato nikkhami.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tassa pana dīpaṅkarakumārassa paṭisandhikkhaṇepi vijātakkhaṇepi dvattiṃsa pubbanimittāni pāṭihāriyāni pāturahesuṃ.
sabbasabbaññubodhisattesu mātu kucchiṃ okkamantesu vijāyantesu sambujjhantesu dhammacakkaṃ pavattantesūti imesu catūsu ṭhānesu dvattiṃsa pāṭihāriyāni pavattanteva.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tatra hissa dasasahassilokadhātukampo sabbaññutaññāṇa paṭilābhassa pubbanimittaṃ.
devatānaṃ ekacakkavāḷe sannipāto dhammacakkappavattana kāle ekappahāreneva sannipatitvā dhammapaṭiggahaṇassa pubbanimittaṃ.
paṭhamaṃ devatānaṃ paṭiggahaṇaṃ catunnaṃ rūpāvacarajjhānānaṃ paṭilābhassa pubbanimittaṃ.
pacchā manussānaṃ paṭiggahaṇaṃ catunnaṃ arūpāvacarajjhānānaṃ paṭilābhassa pubbanimittaṃ.
cammanaddhadundubhīnaṃ sayameva vajjanaṃ mahantiyā dhammabheriyā anusāvanassa pubbanimittaṃ.
bandhanānaṃ sayameva chedo asmimānassa samucchedassa pubbanimittaṃ.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: khagānaṃ nagādīhi pathavigamanaṃ ovādaṃ sutvā mahājanassa pāṇehi saraṇagamanassa.
devatānaṃ sakasaka bhavanesveva ṭhatvā naccādīhi kīḷanaṃ buddhabhāvaṃ patvā udānudānassa.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: atha dīpaṅkarakumāro mahatiyā sampattiyā paricāriyamāno anukkamena bhaddaṃ yobbanaṃ patvā tiṇṇaṃ utūnaṃ anucchavikesu tīsu pāsādesu devalokasiriṃ viya rajjasirimanubhavanto uyyānakīḷāya gamana -samaye anukkamena jiṇṇabyādhimatasaṅkhāte tayo devadūte disvā sañjātasaṃvego nivattitvā sudassananagarasadisavibhavasobhaṃ rammavatīnāma nagaraṃ pāvisi.
nagaraṃ pavisitvā puna catutthavāre hatthācariyaṃ pakkosāpetvā etadavoca “ahaṃ tāta uyyānadassanatthāya nikkhamissāmi hatthiyānāni kappāpehī”ti.
atha vissakammo nāma devaputto bodhisattaṃ nānāvirāgavasananivāsanaṃ āmukkamuttāhārakeyūraṃ ruciranavakanakakaṭakamakuṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ paramasurabhikusumamālasamalaṅkatasiroruhaṃ samalaṅkari kira.

atha dīpaṅkarakumāro devakumāro viya caturāsītiyā hatthisahassehi parivuto hatthikkhandhavaragato mahatā balakāyena parivuto ratijananaṃ uyyānaṃ pavisitvā hatthikkhandhato oruyha taṃ uyyānamanusañcaritvā paramaruciradassane sakahadayasītale silātale nisīditvā pabbajjāya cittaṃ uppādesi.
taṅkhaṇaññeva suddhāvāsakhīṇāsavo mahābrahmā aṭṭha samaṇaparikkhāre ādāya mahāpurisassa cakkhupathe pāturahosi.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: mahāpuriso taṃ disvā “kimida”nti pucchitvā “samaṇaparikkhāro”ti sutvā alaṅkārabhaṇḍaṃ omuñcitvā pasādhanabhaṇḍāgārikassa hatthe datvā maṅgalakhaggamādāya saddhiṃ makuṭena kese chinditvā antalikkhe ākāse ukkhipi.
atha sakko devarājā suvaṇṇacaṅkoṭakena taṃ kesamakuṭaṃ ādāya sinerumuddhani tiyojanappamāṇaṃ indanīlamaṇimayaṃ makuṭacetiyaṃ nāma akāsi.
atha mahāpuriso devadattiyaṃ arahattadhajaṃ kāsāvaṃ paridahitvā sāṭakayugaṃ ākāse khipi.
taṃ brahmā paṭiggahetvā brahmaloke dvādasayojanikaṃ sabbaratanamayaṃ cetiyamakāsi.
tāya pana parisāya parivuto bodhisatto dasamāse padhānacariyaṃ acari.
atha visākhapuṇṇamāya aññataraṃ nagaraṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tasmiṃ kira nagare taṃ divasaṃ devatānaṃ balikaraṇatthāya nirudakapāyāsaṃ paciṃsu.
tassa pana mahāsattassa saparisassa piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa manussā adaṃsu.
taṃ kira sabbesaṃ koṭisaṅkhyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pariyattaṃ ahosi.
mahāpurisassa pana patte devatā dibbojaṃ pakkhipiṃsu.

taṃ paribhuñjitvā tattheva sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye paṭisallānā vuṭṭhāya gaṇaṃ vissajjetvā sunandena nāmājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā pipphalibodhirukkhamūlaṃ gantvā tiṇasanthāraṃ santharitvā navutihatthaṃ bodhikkhandhaṃ piṭṭhito katvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā caturaṅgavīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā bodhirukkhamūle nisīdi.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tato mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā rattiyā paṭhamayāme pubbenivāsaṃ anussaritvā majjhimayāme dibbacakkhuṃ visodhetvā pacchimayāme anulomapaṭilomavasena paccayākāraṃ sammasitvā ānāpānacatutthajjhānaṃ samāpajjitvā tato vuṭṭhāya pañcasu khandhesu abhinivisitvā udayabbayavasena samapaññāya lakkhaṇāni disvā yāva gotrabhuñāṇaṃ vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā aruṇodaye ariyamaggena sakalabuddhaguṇe paṭivijjhitvā buddhasīhanādaṃ naditvā sattasattā haṃ bodhisamīpe yeva vītināmetvā brahmuno dhammadesanaṃ paṭiññāya sunandārāme dhammacakkaṃ pavattetvā koṭisatānaṃ devamanussānaṃ dhammāmataṃ pāyetvā catuddīpikamahāmegho viya dhammavassaṃ vassento mahājanassa bandhanamokkhaṃ karonto janapadacārikaṃ vicari.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tadā kira sumedhapaṇḍito samāpattisukhena vītināmento neva pathavikampanamaddasa.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: atha vā nimittasaddo puṃnapuṃsakavasena dviliṅgikoti daṭṭhabbo.
ettha ca kiñcāpi nimittāni dasasahassilokadhātusaṃkampānādīnaṃ vasena bahūni.
paṭisandhijātibodhidhammacakkappavattanavasena pana catūhi ṭhānehi niyametvā caturo nimitteti vuttaṃ.
idāni tesaṃ catunnaṃ nimittānaṃ adassane kāraṇaṃ niddisanto āha “jhānaratisamappito”ti.
jhānaratisamappito sumedhapaṇḍito ahaṃ tāni nimittāni nāddasanti sambandho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tanninnāti yena buddho, yena dhammo, yena saṃgho.
taṃ patamānā viya ṭhitā hutvāti attho.
tassa āgamanaṃ magganti tena tathāgatena āgantabbaṃ magganti attho.
“tena samayena” ca, “tadā” cāti imesaṃ dvinnaṃ padānaṃ ekatthattā purimassa nikkhamanakiriyāya pacchimassa ca gamanakiriyāya saddhiṃ sambandho veditabbo.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tuṭṭhahaṭṭhaṃ pamoditanti imāni tīṇi padāni aññamaññavevacanāni aññamaññassa atthadīpanāni.
idāni pucchitamatthaṃ dassentena “tuṭṭhahaṭṭho pamudito”ti ādi vuttaṃ.
tattha ayaṃ mahājano tuṭṭhahaṭṭho pamoditahadayo hutvā maggaṃ sodheti.
kassa atthāya tumhehi maggo añjasaṃ vaṭumaṃ ayanaṃ sodhīyatīti evaṃ sakammakriyāpadaṃ ajjhāharitvā attho daṭṭhabbo.
sodhīyateti pana vattabbe vibhattivipallāsavasena sodhīyatīti vuttaṃ.
maggo añjasaṃ vaṭumaṃ ayananti ettha katthaci potthake “magga”nti niggahitantapāṭho dissati.
so na yujjati, maggasaddassa pulliṅgabhāvato idha ca kammapade upayogavacanassa anicchitabbattā.
sodhīyatīti kammavācakapadaṃ hi apekkhitvā kammatthe paccattavacanaṃyeva icchitabbaṃ.
añjasaṃ vaṭumaṃ ayananti pana imāni tīṇi padāni napuṃsakaliṅgikāni yeva.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: 46 udakasambhinnokāsanti dubbisodhanaṃ udakehi sambhinnaṃ ativiya visamaṃ ekaṃ okāsaṃ sallekkhetvāti attho.
analaṅkateyevāti na tāva alaṅkārakicce aniṭṭhite yevāti attho.
pūjayantīsūti ādīsupi tasmiṃyeva atthe bhummavacanaṃ yeva, tena tulyādhikaraṇattā.
devatāsaddaṃ apekkhitvā “pūjayantīsū”ti itthiliṅgavasena vattabbepi tassa atthaṃ apekkhitvā “pūjayantesū”ti pulliṅgavasena vuttaṃ.
tadatthassa hi liṅgasāmaññavisayattā pulliṅgavasena vattuṃ arahati.
manussesūti mānujesu mānusakagandhehi ceva mālādīhi ca pūjayantesūti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: taruṇasīho viyāti idaṃ buddhalīḷāya atidassanīyataṃ pākaṭīkaraṇatthāya vuttaṃ.
taruṇasīho yeva hi manosilātale vijambhamāno atisobhati.
vaggabhedaṭṭhāne pana katthaci bahuvacananto dissati “dve vīsatiyo”ti ādinā.
vaggabhedo ca nāma dve tayoti ādinā rāsikaraṇavasena bhedoti daṭṭhabbo.
tassa sodhīyatīti tassa dīpaṅkarassa jinassa maggo añjasaṃ vaṭumaṃ ayanaṃ sodhīyati suddhabhāvo karīyatīti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: buddho buddhoti kathayantoti abhikkhaṇavacane dvikkhattuṃ vacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: devā manusse passantīti ettha devānaṃ manussadassane vattabbaṃ natthi.
pakatidassanavasena pana yathā manussā idha ṭhatvā passanti.
ubhopi hatthe sirasi patiṭṭhāpetvāti vuttaṃ hoti.
anusaddayoge hi sati sāmiatthe upayogavacanaṃ hoti.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: te hi dīghāyukāpi samānā yathāparicchedaṃ sampattakāle maranti sīlenāti marū.
buddhivipariṇāmakkhayalakkhaṇassa abhāvato maro maraṇaṃ natthi etesanti amarāti ca vuccanti.
hitāya me bhavissatīti taṃ kalale anakkamanaṃ dīgharattaṃ mama hitatthāya bhavissatīti.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: evaṃ meti evaṃ me cetaso āsīti sambandho.
buddhassa mama jīvitaṃ pariccajitvā kalalapiṭṭhe sayanena adhikārenāti attho.
saṃsārasotanti kammakilesavasena yonigativiññāṇaṭhitinavasattāvāsesu ito cito ca saṃsaraṇaṃ saṃsāro.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: māyā nāmāti māyasiriyā sampannāgatattā evaṃ nāmikā devīti attho.
suddhodano nāmāti suddho odano jīvanaṃ etassāti suddhodano.
upatisso nāmāti ettha tissoti nāmaṃ upasaddena yojetvā ruḷhīvasena vuccati.
kolitoti kulati taṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ saṃvaratīti kolito.
sare parepi katthaci anādeso na hoti “nāko”ti ādīsu viya.
buddhabījaṅkuro ayanti ayaṃ sumedhatāpaso buddhabījañca aṅkuro ca hoti kirāti sambandho.
idaṃ sutvāna vacananti idaṃ dīpaṅkarassa bhagavato byākaraṇavacanaṃ sutvā.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: yaṃ taṃ saddaṃ vajjetvā dassitepi sahasaddo asatvavācakattā liṅgaṃ jotetuṃ na sakkoti.
tasmā yaṃ taṃ saddena yojetvā attho kathetabbo.
tathā hi sahadevehi ye lokā te sadevakāti paccattavacanattho upalabbhati.
padānaṃ hi vippakatavacanabhūtena uttarapadena saha samāso na hoti “maggaṃ gacchanto.
tathā hi saddanītiyaṃ -- “na padānaṃ vippakatenuttarena samāso”ti lakkhaṇaṃ vuttaṃ.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: yadi muñcāmāti yadi imaṃ bhagavantaṃ muñcitvā akatakiccā gamissāmāti attho.

abhivādetvāna pakkamuntii devādayo sabbepi ime maṃ tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pupphādīhi pūjetvā suppatiṭṭhitapañcaṅgā vanditvā nivattitvā punappunaṃ oloketvā madhuratthabyañjanāhi nānappakārāhi thutīhi vaṇṇentā pakkamiṃsu.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: dassanaṃ me atikkanteti mama dassanavisayaṃ bhagavati atikkante.

atha sumedhatāpaso dasabalassa byākaraṇaṃ sutvā buddhabhāvaṃ karatalagatakālamiva maññamāno pamuditahadayo dasasu lokadhātusahassesu suddhāvāsamahābrahmāno atītabuddhadassāvino niyatabodhisattānaṃ byākaraṇe uppajjamānapāṭihāriyadassanena tathāgatassa vacanassa avitathataṃ pakāsentā maṃ paritosayantā imā gāthāyo āhaṃsūti dassento “bhagavā pallaṅkābhujane mayha”ntiādi māha.
tathā ca vuttaṃ buddhavaṃsaṭṭhakathāyaṃ “yā pubbeti yāni pubbe.
tattha hi nikāralopaṃ sandhāya vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
atha vā yānīti vattabbe liṅgavipallāsavasena evaṃ vuttaṃ.
tāni ajja padissareti pubbe niyatabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkābhujane yāni nimittāni uppajjiṃsu.
tasmā tvaṃ dhuvameva buddho bhavissasīti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tepajja pupphitāti tāni pupphāni ajja pupphitānīti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tūriyāti atataṃ vitataṃ ātatavitataṃ susiraṃ ghananti pañcatūriyāni.
abhiravantīti tatra tatra kusalehi sumuñcitā suppatāḷitā suvāditā viya abhiravanti.
tepi ajja padissantīti tepi sūriyassa vimalabhāvā tārakā ajja divā dissanti.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: ajjapetaṃti ajja tava pallaṅkabhujanepi etaṃ bhayaṃ na hotevāti attho.
tena liṅgena jānāmāti tena kāraṇena sabbeva mayaṃ jānāma.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: ākāsabhūtāti te kuṭṭakavāṭapabbatā āvaraṇaṃ tirokaraṇaṃ kātuṃ asakkontā.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: dasasahassīna cūbhayanti dīpaṅkarasammāsambuddhassa ca dasasahassacakkavāḷadevatānañca vacanaṃ sutvā.
dhuvaṃ buddho bhavāmahanti ahaṃ ekaṃseneva buddho bhavissāmīti avassambhāvivasena vattamānavacanaṃ katanti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: niyamavasena niddosaṃ katvā vā nirantaravasena vā sevitaṃ.
kattha nu kho te buddhakarā dhammā uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ disāsu vidisāsūti adhippāyo.
ajja paṭṭhāya ayaṃ paṭhamaṃ dānapāramī pūretabbā mayāti evaṃ samādiyāti adhippāyo.
yassa kassacīti udakassa vā khīrassa vā takkassa vā rasassa vā yassa kassaci sampuṇṇo.
na tattha parirakkhatīti tasmiṃ vamane na parirakkhati.
camarīmigoti ettha camarīmigo nāma dīghalomo eko migaviseso.
dutiyaṃ sīlapāraminti sīlaṃ nāma sabbesaṃ kusaladhammānaṃ patiṭṭhā.
tasmā sīlapāramī pūretabbāti dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ addakkhinti attho.
catūsu bhūmīsūti pātimokkhasaṃvara inrdiyasaṃvara ājīvapārisuddhi paccayasannissitavasena catūsu ṭhānesu.
kiṃ sāvajjaṃ, kiṃ anavajjaṃ”ntiādinā nayena tattha tattha abhiññāte paṇḍite jane upasaṅkamitvā paripucchantoti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: kadāci khamanaṃ, kadāci akhamanaṃ, kassaci khamanaṃ, kassaci akhamananti evaṃ dvidhābhāvaṃ anāpannamānaso hutvā.
osadhagahaṇe osadhītārakaṃ uditaṃ disvā osadhaṃ gaṇhanti.
na vokkamati vīthitoti taṃ taṃ utumhi attano gamanavīthito na vokkamati.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: taṃ taṃ phaladānaṃ okkamma phalaṃ adatvā na nivattati.
yathā tulāya daṇḍo samaṃ tulito samaṃ tiṭṭhati.
evameva tvampi sukhadukkhesu tulāsadiso hutvā sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasi.
so ca ekatthe bahvatthe ca vattati.
keci pana anekabhedato cassa kāmatoti avatvā kāmehīti vuttanti aṭṭhakathāvacanaṃ nissāya tosaddo ekatthe yevāti vadanti.
aṭṭhakathāyaṃ hi tosaddassa ekatthabahvatthesu pavattanato sāmaññavasena avatvā kāmassa anekabhedatthe pākaṭīkaraṇatthaṃ kāmehīti nissaṃsayavasena visesetvā vuttanti adhippāyo gahetabboti.
tosaddo hi tratha-saddādayo viya ekatthabahvatthesu vattantīti alamatippapañcena.
tato dasapāramito añño buddhakārakadhammo natthīti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: mukhyato pana sivirājassa apekkhato dve dārake ākoṭayanto ādāya gacchatītiādīsu anādaralakkhaṇaṃ upalabbhati.
tadaññesu pana mahārājassa supantassa supinaṃ passatītiādīsu dvinnaṃ bhāvānaṃ ekakkhaṇe upalabhitabbatāsāmaññena anādaralakkhaṇaṃ veditabbaṃ.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: dvinnaṃ hi bhāvānaṃ ekakkhaṇe upalabhitabbhatāyeva anādaralakkhaṇaṃ nāmāti gahetabbaṃ.
taṃ dhāreti, virati vā, dhīyati vā etthāti vasudhā.
sumedhapaṇḍite pana pāramiyo vicinante tassa ñāṇatejena dasasahassī pakampitthāti attho.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: mano nibbāyīti mahājanassa pathavikampane ubbiggahadayassa satthuvacanaṃ sutvā mano nibbāyi.
dibbanti mandāravapāricchattakasantānakuse sayādikaṃ dibbakusumaṃ devā ca dibbaṃ mānusakā ca mānusakaṃ pupphaṃ gahetvāti attho.
atha vā atthisaddo sundaratthe nipātoti daṭṭhabbo.
sabbesaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikānaṃ sundarānaṃ kalyāṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atthi sotthi.
idāni vedayitākāradassanatthaṃ mahantaṃ patthitaṃ tuyhantiādi vuttaṃ.
tayā pana sumedhapaṇḍita mahantaṃ ṭhānaṃ patthitaṃ.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: soko rogo vinassatūti socana saṅkhāto soko rujanasaṅkhāto rogo ca vinassatu.

before.title: dvattiṃsa pubbanimitta
lines: tehi vā thavitabbehi dīpaṅkarādīhi pasatthoti thutappasattho.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: satthā tesaṃ dhammaṃ desetvāti atha satthā tesaṃ paramamadhura hadayaṅgamaṃ dānānumodanādikaṃ akāsi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: kañci pañcasu sīlesūti kañci puggalaṃ pañcasu viratisīlesu nivesetīti attho.
sīle dasavidhe paranti aparaṃ puggalaṃ dasavidhe sīle nivesetīti attho.
iminā ca pana dasavidhaṃ sīlaṃ gihīnampi samādayituṃ vaṭṭatīti attho viññātabbo.
ettha keci vitaṇḍavādino evaṃ vadanti “gihīnaṃ dasavidhaṃ sīlaṃ samādayituṃ na vaṭṭatī”ti.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa kañci puggalaṃ dasakusalakamme samādapesīti attho.
kassaci deti sāmaññanti ettha paramatthato sāmaññanti maggo vuccati.
yathāha -- katamañca bhikkhave sāmaññaṃ ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
seyyathidaṃ -- sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: kassaci asame dhammeti kassaci asadise cattāro paṭisambhidādhamme adāsi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: kassaci varasamāpattiyoti kassaci pana nīvaraṇavigamena padhānabhūtā aṭṭha samāpattiyo adāsi.
tisso kassaci vijjāyoti kassaci puggalassa upanissayavasena dibbacakkhuñāṇapubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaāsavakkhayañāṇānaṃ vasena tisso vijjāyo.
ito uparipi īdisesu vacanesu atītakālavasena attho gahetabbo.
mahāhanūti mahāpurisānaṃ kira dvepi hanūni paripuṇṇāni dvādasiyā pakkhassa candasadisākārāni hontīti mahantāni hanūni yassa so mahāhanu.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: bahū jane tārayatīti bahū buddhaveneyye jane tāresi.
idaṃ pana dasasahassaṃ lokadhātuṃyeva sandhāya vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dīpaṅkaro hi kira satthā buddhattaṃ patvā bodhimūle sattasattāhāni vītināmetvā aṭṭhame sattāhe mahābrahmuno dhammajjhesanaṃ paṭiññāya sunandārāme dhammacakkaṃ pavattetvā koṭisataṃ devamanussānaṃ dhammāmataṃ pāyesi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: atha satthā attano puttassa samavaṭṭakkhandhassa usabhakkhandhassa nāma ñāṇaparipākaṃ ñatvā taṃ atrajaṃ pamukhaṃ katvā rāhulovādasadisaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā devamanussānaṃ navutikoṭiyo dhammāmataṃ pāyesi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: puna bhagavā amaravatīnagaradvāre mahāsirisarukkhamūle yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ katvā mahājanassa bandhanāmokkhaṃ katvā devagaṇaparivuto divasakarātirekajutīhi tāvatiṃsabhavane pāricchattakamūle paramasiritale paṇḍukambalasilātale nisīditvā sabbadevagaṇapītisañjananiṃ attano jananiṃ sumedhādeviṃ pamukhaṃ katvā devagaṇaparivuto sabbalokaviditavisuddhidevo devadevo dīpaṅkaro bhagavā sabbasattahitakārakaṃ paramātirekagambhīrasukhumaṃ buddhavisayaṃ abhidhammapiṭakaṃ desetvā navutidevakoṭisahassānaṃ dhammāmataṃ pāyesi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dīpaṅkarassa pana bhagavato tayo sāvakasannipātā ahesuṃ.
tattha sunandārāme koṭisatasahassānaṃ paṭhamo sannipāto ahosi.

athāparena samayena dasabalo catūhi bhikkhusatasahassehi parivuto gāmanigamanagarapaṭipāṭiyā mahājanānuggahaṃ karonto cārikaṃ caramāno anukkamena ekasmiṃ padese mahājanassa katasakkāraṃ sabbalokavissutaṃ amanussapariggahitaṃ atibhayānakaṃ olambāmbudharaparicumbitakūṭaṃ vividhasurabhitarukusumavāsitakūṭaṃ nānāmiṇavicaritakūṭaṃ nāradakūṭaṃ** nāma paramaramaṇīyaṃ pabbataṃ sampāpuṇi.
so kira pabbato nāradena nāma yakkhena pariggahito ahosi.
tattha pana tassa yakkhassa anusaṃvaccharaṃ mahājano manussabaliṃ upasaṃharati.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: atha dīpaṅkaro kira bhagavā tassa mahājanassa upanissayasampattiṃ disvā tato bhikkhusaṃghaṃ cātuddisaṃ pesetvā adutiyo asahāyo mahākaruṇābalavasaṅgatahadayo tañca yakkhaṃ vinetuṃ taṃ nāradapabbataṃ abhiruhi.
atha so manussabhakkho sakahitanirapekkho paravadhadakkho yakkho makkhaṃ asahamāno kodhaparetamānaso dasabalaṃ bhiṃsāpetvā palāpetukāmo taṃ pabbataṃ cālesi.
so kira pabbato tena cāliyamano bhagavato ānubhāvena tasseva matthake patamāno viya ahosi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tato so bhīto “handa naṃ agginā jhāpessāmī”ti mahantaṃ atibhīmadassanaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbattesi.
so aggikkhandho paṭivāte khitto viya attanova dukkhaṃ janesi.
na pana bhagavato cīvare aṃsumattampi daḍḍhuṃ samattho ahosi.

yakkho pana “samaṇo daḍḍho, na daḍḍho”ti olokento dasabalaṃ saradasamaye vimalakaranikaraṃ sabbajanaratikaraṃ rajanikaramiva sītalajalatalagatakamalakaṇṇikāya nisinnaṃ viya bhagavantaṃ disvā cintesi “aho ayaṃ samaṇo mahānubhāvo.
imaṃ pana samaṇaṃ muñcitvā aññaṃ me paṭisaraṇaṃ parāyaṇaṃ natthi.
pathaviyaṃ upakkhalitā pathaviṃ yeva nissāya uṭṭhahanti.
handāhaṃ imaṃ yeva samaṇaṃ saraṇaṃ gamissāmī”ti.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: athevaṃ pana so cintetvā bhagavato cakkālaṅkatalesu pādesu sirasā nipatitvā “accayo maṃ bhante accagamā”ti vatvā bhagavantaṃ saraṇamāgamāsi.
so desanāpariyosāne dasahi yakkhasatehi saddhiṃ sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahi.
tasmiṃ kira divase sakalajambudīpatalavāsino manussā tassa balikammatthāya ekekagāmato ekekaṃ purisaṃ āhariṃsu.
atha so yakkho taṃ divasaṃ ābhatataṇḍulādikaṃ sabbaṃ tesaṃyeva datvā te balikammatthāya ānītamanusse dasabalassa niyyātesi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: atha satthā te manusse ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbājetvā antosattāheyeva sabbe arahatte patiṭṭhapesi.
māghapuṇṇamāya koṭisata- bhikkhumajjhagato caturaṅgasamannāgate sannipāte pātimokkhamuddisi.
caturaṅgāni nāma sabbeva ehibhikkhu honti, sabbe chaḷabhiññā honti, sabbe anāmantitāva āgatā, pannarasūposathodivaso cāti imāni cattāri aṅgāni nāma.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: yamhi kāletiādīsu mahāvīro muni yadā sudassanasiluccaye vasi.
ayaṃ pana gāthā [ahaṃ tena samayenātiādi. abhi. ṭṭha. 1. 42.] idha ca aṭṭhasāliniyā nāma dhammasaṅgahaṭṭhakathāya nidānasaṃvaṇṇanāya dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃse likhitā.
dīpaṅkare kira bhagavati dhammaṃ desente dasasahassānañca vīsatiṃsacattālīsasahassānañca dhammābhisamayo ahosiyeva.
ekassa pana dvinnaṃ tiṇṇaṃ catunnanti ca evamādivasena abhisamayānaṃ anto natthi.
tasmā dīpaṅkarassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ ahosi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ asaṅkhyeyyābhisamayattā ca vitthārikaṃ mahantappattaṃ bahūhi paṇḍitehi devamanussehi niyyānikanti jaññaṃ jānitabbaṃ adhisīlasikkhādīhi iddhañca samādhiādīhi phītañca ahosi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tattha suvisodhitanti suṭṭhu bhagavatā sodhitaṃ visuddhaṃ kataṃ.
dīpaṅkaraṃ kira satthāraṃ sabbakālaṃ chaḷabhiññānaṃ mahiddhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cattālīsa sahassāni parivārenti.
tena ca samayena ye sekkhā kālaṃ karonti.
sabbe khīṇāsavā hutvā yeva parinibbāyantīti adhippāyo.
tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ supupphitaṃ susamiddhaṃ khīṇāsavehi bhikkhūhi ativiya sobhittha.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tattha cattāri sahassānīti gaṇanāya dassitā evaṃ dassitagaṇanā ime bhikkhūti dassanatthaṃ “chaḷabhiññā mahiddhikā”ti vuttanti evamattho gahetabbo.
atha vā chaḷabhiññā mahiddhikāti chaḷabhiññānaṃ mahiddhikānanti sāmiatthe paccattavacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
bhagavantaṃ muñcitvā katthaci na gacchantīti adhippāyo.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ vuttesu navasu atthesu kāle daṭṭhabbo.
appamattamānasāti appattaṃ anadhigataṃ mānasaṃ yehi te appamattamānasā.
mānasanti rāgassa ca cittassa ca arahattassa ca adhivacanaṃ.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: yvāhaṃ carati mānaso”ti [vi. 3.28.] hi ettha pana rāgo “mānaso”ti vutto.
“cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍara”nti [mahāni. 2.] ettha cittaṃ.
kālaṃ kayirā janesutā”ti [buddhavaṃsa. ṭṭha. 155.] ettha arahattaṃ.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā sampannāgato hoti.pa.
ettāvatā kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sekho hotī”ti. [saṃ. 3. 12. itivut. ṭṭha. 57.] api ca sikkhantīti sekhā.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sikkhatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā “sekho”ti vuccatī”ti. [itivut. ṭṭha. 58.]

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: pāvacananti pasatthaṃ vacanaṃ, vuddhippattaṃ vā vacanaṃ pāvacanaṃ.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa dīpaṅkarassa bhagavato rammavatī nāma nagaraṃ ahosi.
bodhi tassa bhagavato pipphali nāma rukkho ahosi.
kiṃ panetaṃ jātanagarādīnaṃ dassane payojananti ce?
vuccate -- yassa yadi neva jātanagaraṃ na pitā na mātā paññāyeyya.
imassa pana neva jātanagaraṃ na pitā na mātā paññāyati.
devo vā sakko vā yakkho vā māro vā brahmā vā esa maññe.
devānampi īdisaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ anacchariyanti maññamānā na sotabbaṃ na saddahitabbaṃ maññeyyaṃ.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tattha sudevo nāma khattiyoti sudevo nāmassa khattiyo pitā ahosīti attho.
so hi phalassa khuddakattā rukkhassa ca mahantattā virūpaṃ visadisaṃ phalaṃ etassa atthīti “pipphalī”ti vuccati.

dīparukkho vāti sampajjalitadīpamālā dhāraṇo dīparukkho viya ārohapariṇāhasaṇṭhāna- pāripūrisampanno dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇānubyañjanasamalaṅkatasarīro vipphuritaraṃsijālāvisaratārāgaṇasamujjalamiva gaganatalaṃ bhagavā dharamānakāle sobhittha.
sālarājāva phullitoti pupphito sabbadā sabbaphāliphullo sālarājarukkho viya ca sabbaphāliphullo yojanasatubbedho pāricchattako viya ca asītihatthubbedho bhagavā ativiya sobhati.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sā ca iddhīti sā ca sampatti ānubhāvo.
sabbaṃ tamantarahitanti taṃ sabbaṃ vuttappakāraṃ sampattijātaṃ antarahitaṃ apagatanti attho.
nanu rittā sabbasaṅkhārāti sabbe pana saṅkhatadhammā nanu rittā tucchā.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: ettha pana nagarādiparicchedo pāḷiyaṃ yeva āgato.
yasmā pana vattuṃ okāse sampatte sabbampi vattabbavacanaṃ vitthārenāpi vattuṃ yuttaṃ.
tasmā aṭṭhāne vitthārena vuttanti doso nāropetabboyeva.
puttaparicchedo bhariyaparicchedo pāsādaparicchedo agāravāsaparicchedo nāṭakitthiparicchedo abhinikkhamanaparicchedo padhānaparicchedo vihāraparicchedo upaṭṭhākaparicchedoti.
tassa pana dīpaṅkarassa bhariyānaṃ tisatasahassaṃ ahosi.
haṃsā koñcā mayūrāti tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sabbabuddhānaṃ pana pañca vemattāni honti āyuvemattaṃ pamāṇavemattaṃ kulavemattaṃ padhānavemattaṃ rasmivemattanti.
tattha āyuvemattaṃ nāma keci dīghāyukā honti keci appāyukā.
tathā hi dīpaṅkarassa pana bhagavato vassasatasahassaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: pamāṇavemattaṃ nāma keci dīghā honti keci rassā.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: padhānavemattaṃ nāma kesañci padhānaṃ ittarameva hoti yathā kassapassa bhagavato, kesañci addhaniyaṃ amhākaṃ bhagavato viya.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: rasmivemattaṃ nāma maṅgalassa bhagavato sarīrarasmi dasasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā aṭṭhāsi.
paṭividdhaguṇesu pana kassaci vemattaṃ nāma natthi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tathā sabbabuddhānaṃ cattāri avijahitaṭṭhānāni nāma honti.
so pana khuddako vā mahanto vā hoti.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: aparaṃ pana amhākaṃ yeva bhagavato sahajātaparicchedañca nakkhattaparicchedañca visesaṃ.
amhākaṃ sabbaññubodhisattena kira saddhiṃ rāhulamātā ānandatthero channatthero kaṇḍako assarājā nidhikumbhā mahābodhirukkho kāḷudāyīti imāni satta sahajātāni.
visākhanakkhattena jāto ca abhisambuddho ca parinibbuto ca.
māghanakkhattena tassa sāvakasannipāto ceva āyusaṅkhāravosajjanañca ahosi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: iti bhagavā dīpaṅkaro yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā sabbabuddhakiccaṃ katvā anukkamena anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyi.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tasmiṃ aññepi taṇhaṅkaro medhaṅkaro saraṇaṅkaroti tayo buddhā ahesuṃ.
aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana tamhā kappā ādito paṭṭhāya uppannupanne sabbabuddhe dassetuṃ idaṃ vuttaṃ --

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: maṅgalo ca sumano ca. revato sobhito muni.

before.title: dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tisso phusso ca sambuddho. vipassī sikhī vessabhū.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tattha koṇḍañño nāma satthā udapādīti koṇḍañño nāma bhagavā soḷasaasaṅkhyeyyaṃ kappānañca satasahassaṃ pāramiyo pūretvā vessantarattabhāvasadise attabhāve ṭhatvā tato cavitvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā devatānaṃ paṭiññaṃ datvā tusitapurato cavitvā rammavatīnagare sunandassa nāma rañño kule sujātāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ aggahesi.
tassapi paṭisandhikkhaṇe dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṃse vuttappakārāni dvattiṃsapāṭihāriyāni nibbattiṃsu.

so devatāhi katārakkhasaṃvidhāno dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena mātukucchito nikkhamitvā sabbasattuttaro uttarābhimukho sattapadavītihārena gantvā sabbā ca disā viloketvā āsabhiṃ vācaṃ nicchāresi “aggohamasmi lokassa.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tato kumārassa nāmakaraṇadivase nāmaṃ karontā “koṇḍañño”ti nāmamakaṃsu.
tassa kira tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ rāmasurāmasubhavasena.
tesu tīṇi satasahassāni nāṭakitthīnaṃ naccagītavāditakusalānaṃ sabbakālaṃ paccupaṭṭhitāni ahesuṃ.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so pana jiṇṇabyādhimatapabbajite disvā ājaññarathena nikkhamitvā pabbajitvā dasa māse padhānacariyaṃ cari.
koṇḍaññakumāraṃ pana pabbajantaṃ dasa janakoṭiyo anupabbajiṃsu.

so tehi parivuto dasa māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sunandagāme samasahitaghanapayodharāya yasodharāya nāma seṭṭhidhītāya dinnaṃ paramamadhuraṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā phalapallavaṅkurasamalaṅkate sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye gaṇaṃ pahāya sunandakājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā sālakalyāṇirukkhaṃ tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pubbadisabhāgaṃ oloketvā bodhirukkhaṃ piṭṭhito katvā aṭṭhapaṇṇāsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ bandhitvā caturaṅgavīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhāya mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā rattiyā paṭhamayāme pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ visodhetvā majjhimayāme dibbacakkhuṃ visodhetvā pacchimayāme paccayākāraṃ sammasitvā ānāpānacatutthajjhānato vuṭṭhāya pañcasu khandhesu abhinivisitvā udayabbayavasena samapaññāsalakkhaṇāni disvā yāva gotrabhuñāṇaṃ vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā cattāri maggañāṇāni cattāri ca phalañāṇāni catasso paṭisambhidā catuyoniparicchedakañāṇaṃ pañcagatiparicchedakañāṇaṃ cha asādhāraṇañāṇāni sakale ca buddhaguṇe paṭivijjhitvā sadevake loke pātubhavīti attho.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassanti koṇḍañño kira satthā abhisambodhiṃ patvā paṭhamavassaṃ candavatīnagaraṃ upanissāya candārāme vihāsi.

tattha sucindharassa nāma brāhmaṇamahāsalassa putto bhaddamāṇavo nāma yasodharabrāhmaṇassa putto subhaddamāṇavo ca koṇḍaññassa buddhassa sammukhā dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pasannamānasā dasahi māṇavakasahassehi saddhiṃ tassa santike pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.
