before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: atha koṇḍañño satthā jeṭṭhamāsapuṇṇamāya subhaddattherappamukhena koṭisatasahassena parivuto pātimokkhamuddisi.
dutiye koṭisahassanti tato aparabhāge koṇḍaññasatthuno putte vijitasene nāma arahattaṃ patte taṃpamukhassa koṭisahassassa majjhe bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.
tatiye navutikoṭiyoti aparena samayena dasabalo janapadacārikaṃ caranto udenarājānaṃ nāma navutikoṭijanaparivāraṃ pabbājesi saddhiṃ tāya parisāya.
tasmiṃ pana arahattaṃ patte taṃpamukhehi navutiyā arahantakoṭīhi bhagavā parivuto pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: bodhisattoti ettha satipi sambhave byabhicārassa abhāvato asuko

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dvīsu hi visesanopādānaṅgesu sambhavabyabhicārisu byabhicāroyeva visesanopādāne padhānakāraṇanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sāmaññe hi sati taṃ paṭicca suṇantānaṃ anekesu atthesu pasaṅgañāṇaṃ uppajjati.
tathā hi bodhisattoti sāmaññavacanaṃ amhākaṃ bodhisattoti visesatthaṃ viññāpeti.
vijitāvī nāma cakkavatti hutvāti candavatīnagare vijitāvī nāma cakkavatti hutvā.
koṭisatasahassasaṅkhassa buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa mahādānaṃ adāsīti koṇḍañño nāma bhagavā koṭisatasahassakhīṇāsavaparivuto janapadacārikaṃ caramāno anupubbena candavatīnagaraṃ sampāpuṇi.

bodhisatto kira “sammāsambuddho amhākaṃ nagaraṃ anuppatto”ti sutvā paccuggantvā bhagavato vasanaṭṭhānaṃ saṃvidahitvā svātanāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena nimantetvā punadivase bhattavidhiṃ suṭṭhu pariyādetvā koṭisatasahassasaṅkhassa buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa mahādānaṃ adāsi.
bodhisatto bhagavantaṃ bhojetvā anumodanāvasāne “bhante temāsaṃ mahājanasaṅgahaṃ karonto idheva vasathā”ti yācitvā tayo māse nirantaraṃ buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa asadisamahādānaṃ adāsi.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sālakalyāṇirukkho bodhīti ettha sālakalyāṇirukkho nāma eko rukkhaviseso.
so buddhakāle ceva cakkavattikāle ca nibbatti.
adhunā tassa rukkhassa loke apavattanato “kīdiso eso”ti niyametvā kathetuṃ na sakkā.

before.title: koṇḍaññabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: idāni buddhavaṃse āgataṃ gāthāpadaṃ ānetvā dassetuṃ “dīpaṅkarassa aparenā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
tattha dīpaṅkarassa aparenāti dīpaṅkarassa satthuno aparabhāgeti attho.
heṭṭhato avīci uparito bhavaggaṃ tiriyato anantā lokadhātuyo etthantare ekapuggalopi tassa mukhaṃ oloketvā ṭhātuṃ samattho nāma natthi.
tassa hi bhagavato vassasatasahassāni yāva parinibbānasamayaṃ etthantare bhikkhuparisāya gaṇanaparicchedo nāma nāhosi.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: koṇḍaññe kira satthari parinibbute tassa sāsanaṃ vassasatasahassaṃ pavattittha.

so pana bhagavā kappasatasahassādhikāni soḷasaasaṅkhyeyāni pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā pañcasu pubbanimittesu uppannesu devatāyo ekasmiṃ cakkavāḷe sannipatitvā āyāciṃsu --

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ yadā devatānaṃ buddhakolāhalaṃ nāma udapādi.
tadā dasasahassacakkavāḷadevehi āyācito katapañcavilokano tusitā kāyā cavitvā sabbanagaruttame uttaranagare anuttarassa uttarassa nāma rañño kule uttarāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhi.

tassā uttarāya kira mahādeviyā kucchismiṃ sabbalokamaṅgalassa maṅgalassa mahāsattassa paṭisandhiggahaṇato paṭṭhāya sarīrappabhā rattindivaṃ asītihatthappamāṇaṃ padesaṃ pharitvā candālokasūriyālokehi anabhibhavanīyā hutvā aṭṭhāsi.
sā ca aññena ālokena vinā attano sarīrappabhāsamudayeneva andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā aṭṭhasaṭṭhiyā dhātīhi paricāriyamānā vicari.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sā kira devatāhi katārakkhā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena paramasurabhikusumaphaladharasākhāviṭape kamalakuvalayasamalaṅkate rurusīha byagghagajagavayamahiṃsapasadavividhamigagaṇavicarite paramaramaṇīye uttaramadhuruyyāne nāma maṅgaluyyāne maṅgalamahāpurisaṃ vijāyi.
so jātamattova mahāsatto sabbā disā viloketvā uttarābhimukho sattapadavītihārena gantvā āsabhiṃ vācaṃ nicchāresi.
tasmiñca khaṇe sakaladasasahassilokadhātūsu devatā dissamānasarīrā dibbamālādīhi samalaṅkatagattā tattha tattha ṭhatvā jayamaṅgalathutivacanāni sampavattayiṃsu.
nāmaggahaṇadivase panassa lakkhaṇapāṭhakā sabbamaṅgalasampattiyā jātoti “maṅgalakumāro”tveva nāmaṃ kariṃsu.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa kira yasavā rucimā sirimāti tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

tattha mahāsatto navavassasahassāni dibbasukhasadisaṃ sukhaṃ anubhavitvā yasavatiyā aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ sīlavaṃ nāma puttaṃ labhitvā cattāri nimittāni disvā alaṅkataṃ paṇḍaraṃ nāma sundaraturaṅgavaramāruyha mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.
taṃ pana pabbajantaṃ tisso manussakoṭiyo anupabbajiṃsu.
tehi parivuto mahāpuriso aṭṭhamāse padhānacariyaṃ acari.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tato visākhapuṇṇamāya uttaragāme uttaraseṭṭhino dhītāya uttarāya nāma dinnaṃ pakkhittadibbojaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā surabhikusumālaṅkate nīlobhāse manorame sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā uttarena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā asitañjanagirisaṅkāsaṃ akkantavarakanakajālakūṭaṃva sītacchāyaṃ vividhamigagaṇasampātavirahitaṃ mandamāluteritāya ghanasākhāya samalaṅkataṃ naccantamiva pītiyā virocamānaṃ nāgabodhiṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pubbuttarapasse ṭhatvā aṭṭhapaṇṇāsa- hatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā tattha pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ vīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā paṭhamaṃ māraṃ sabalaṃ viddhaṃsetvā pubbenivāsadibbacakkhuñāṇāni paṭilabhitvā anukkamena anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ sampatto.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: koṭisatasahassaṃ bhikkhū ahesunti maṅgale kira lokanāthe mekhalapure viharante tasmiṃyeva pure sudevo ca dhammadesano ca māṇavakā māṇavakasahassehi parivāritā tassa bhagavato santike ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajiṃsu.
māghapuṇṇamāya dvīsu aggasāvakesu saparivāresu arahattaṃ pattesu satthā koṭisatasahassabhikkhugaṇamajjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye koṭisahassanti uttarārāme nāma anuttare ñātisamāgame pabbajitānaṃ koṭisahassānaṃ [koṭisatasahassānaṃ. buddhavaṃsa. 327.] samāgame pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sunandakumāro nāmāti [ānandakumāro nāmāti. jā. ṭṭha. 1. 37.] sunando nāma kumāro cakkavattirājā hutvā navutikoṭisaṅkhāya parisāya saddhiṃ dhammassavanatthāya satthusantikaṃ agamāsīti attho.
kharadāṭhiko nāma yakkhoti kharadāṭhāya bheravasaṇṭhānattā kharadāṭhiko nāma manussabhakkho mahesakkho yakkho.
dve dāraketi putto ca dhītā cāti dve dārake.

mūlakalāpe viya dve dārake khādī**ti taṃ brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ pahāya analajālapiṅgalavirūpanayano visamavirūpakuṭilabhimadāṭho vivaṭavirūpanāso kapilapharusadīghakeso navadaḍḍhatālakkhandhasadisakāyo hutvā te dārake mūlakalāpe viya gahetvā khādi.

before.title: maṅgalabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: idāni yathāvuttavacanaṃ buddhavaṃsapāḷiyā nigamento āha “koṇḍaññassa aparenā”tiādi.
dhammokkanti ettha ayaṃ pana ukkāsaddo suvaṇṇakāramūsādīsu anekesu atthesu dissati.
tathā hi “saṇḍāsena jātarūpaṃ gahetvā ukkāmukhe pakkhipeyyā”ti [ma. 3. 286.] āgataṭṭhāne suvaṇṇakārānaṃ mūsā “ukkā”ti veditabbā.
ukkaṃ bandhitvā ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpeyyā”ti [ma. 3.286.] āgataṭṭhāne kammārānaṃ aṅgārakapallaṃ.
anto jhāyati no bahī”ti [jā. 2. 209.] āgataṭṭhāne kammāruddhanaṃ.
“evaṃ vipāko ukkāpāto bhavissatī”ti [dī. 1. 10.] āgataṭṭhāne vāyuvego “ukkā”ti vuccati.
avijjandhakārapaṭicchannassa avijjandhakārābhibhūtassa lokassa dhammamayaṃ ukkaṃ dhāresīti attho.

before.title: sumanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sumano nāma satthā udapādīti navutivassasahassāyukesu manussesu anukkamena parihāyitvā dasavassesu jātesu puna vaḍḍhitvā anukkamena asaṅkhyeyyāyukā hutvā puna parihāyitvā navutivassasahassāyukesu jātesu sumano nāma bodhisatto pāramiyo pūretvā tusita- pure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā mekhalanagare sudattassa nāma rañño kule sirimāyā nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā heṭṭhā vuttanayena saha pāṭihāriyehi mātukucchito nikkhamitvā anukkamena vuḍḍhippatto sirivaḍḍhana somavaḍḍhana iddhivaḍḍhananāmadheyyesu tīsu pāsādesu tesaṭṭhiyā nāṭakitthisatasahassehi paricāriyamāno devakumāro viya navavassasahassāni dibbasukhasadisaṃ sukhaṃ anubhavamāno vaṭaṃsikāya nāma deviyā anupamaṃ nāma nirupamaṃ puttaṃ janetvā cattāri nimittāni disvā hatthiyānena nikkhamitvā tiṃsakoṭimanussehi saddhiṃ pabbajitvā tehi parivuto dasamāse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya anomanigame anomaseṭṭhino dhītāya anupamāya nāma dinnaṃ pakkhittadibbojaṃ pāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā anupamājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā nāgabodhiṃ upagantvā taṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā aṭṭhahi tiṇamuṭṭhīhi tiṃsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ katvā tattha pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā paṇḍukambalasilāsane sakko viya nisīditvā mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭibujjhitvā sumano nāma satthā udapādi.

before.title: sumanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassabhikkhū ahesunti mekhalanagaraṃ upanissāya vassaṃ vasitvā paṭhamapavāraṇāya arahantānaṃ koṭisatasahassehi ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitehi saddhiṃ bhagavā pavāresi.

before.title: sumanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye kañcanapabbatamhi navutikoṭisahassānīti aparena samayena saṅkassanagarassa avidūre arindamarājakusalabalanibbatte yojanappamāṇe kañcanapabbate nisinno saradasamayarucirakaranikaro divākaro viya yugandharapabbate munivaradivākaro arindamarājānaṃ parivāretvā āgatānaṃ purisānaṃ navutikoṭisahassāni dametvā sabbe ehibhikkhu- pabbajāya pabbajetvā tasmiṃyeva divase arahattaṃ pattehi bhikkhūhi parivuto caturaṅgasampannāgate sannipāte pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: sumanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiyo asītikoṭisahassānīti yadā pana sakko devarājā sugatassa dassanatthāya upasaṅkami.
tadā sumano bhagavā asītiyā arahantakoṭisahassehi parivuto pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.
asamasamānoti [sabbadhammehi asamoti. jā. ṭṭha. 1. 42.] sabbadhammehi karaṇabhūtehi visesanabhūtehi vā asamehi purimabuddhehi samānoti attho.

before.title: revatabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: revato nāma satthā udapādīti tassa sāsane antarahite navutivassasahassāyukā manussā anukkamena parihāyitvā dasavassāyukā hutvā puna anukkamena vaḍḍhetvā asaṅkhyeyyāyukā hutvā puna parihāyamānā saṭṭhivassasahassāyukā ahesuṃ.

sopi pāramiyo pūretvā anekaratanasamujjalite tusitabhavane nibbattitvā tato cavitvā sudhaññavatīnagare sabbālaṅkārasamalaṅkataamitaruciraparivāraparivutassa sirivibhavasamudayenākulassa sabbasamiddhivipulassa vipulassa nāma rañño kule sabbajananayanālipālisamākulāya samphullanayanakuvalayasassi rikasiniddhavadanakamalākarasobhāsamujjalāya suruciramanoharaguṇagaṇavipulāya vipulāya nāma aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena cittakūṭapabbatato suvaṇṇahaṃsarājā viya mātukucchito nikkhami.

before.title: revatabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: ettha ca sabbesaṃ buddhānaṃ pāṭihāriyāni sadisāniyeva.
tāhi parivuto so surayuvatīhi parivuto devakumāro viya chabbassasahassāni dibbasukhaṃ viya sukhamanubhāvamāno agāraṃ ajjhāvasi.

so sudassanāya nāma deviyā varuṇe nāma tanaye jāte cattāri nimittāni disvā nānāvirāgatanuvaravasananivasano āmukkamuttāhāramaṇikuṇḍalo varakeyūramakuṭakaṭakadharo paramasurabhigandhakusumasamalaṅkato paramarucirakaranikaro saradasamayarajanikaro viya tārāgaṇaparivuto viya cando tidasagaṇaparivuto viya dasasatanayano brāhmaṇaparivutā viya ca hāritamahābrahmā caturaṅginiyā mahatiyā senāya parivuto ājaññarathena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā sabbābharaṇāni omuñcitvā bhaṇḍāgārikassa hatthe datvā jalajāmalavikalanīlakuvalayadalasadisenātinisitenātitikhiṇenāsinā sakesamakuṭaṃ chinditvā ākāse khipi.
taṃ sakko devarājā suvaṇṇacaṅkoṭakena paṭiggahetvā tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ netvā sinerumuddhani sattaratanamayaṃ cetiyaṃ akāsi.

before.title: revatabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: mahāpuriso pana devadattāni kāsāyāni paridahitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto sattamāse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya aññatarāya sādhudeviyā nāma seṭṭhidhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divivāhāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye aññatarena ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā mattavaranāgo viya nāgabodhiṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tepaṇṇāsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā caturaṅgavīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhāya nisīditvā mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭivijjhitvā buddho loke udapādi.

before.title: revatabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte gaṇanā natthīti sudhaññavatīnagare paṭhamamahāpātimokkhuddese ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ arahantānaṃ gaṇanapathaṃ vītivattānaṃ paṭhamo sannipāto ahosi.

before.title: revatabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye koṭisatasahassabhikkhū ahesunti mekhalanagare koṭisatasahassasaṅkhānaṃ ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ arahantānaṃ dutiyo sannipāto ahosi.

before.title: revatabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tathā tatiyeti revatassa pana bhagavato dhammacakkānuvattako varuṇo nāma aggasāvako paññavantānaṃ aggo ābādhiko ahosi.

tassa gilānapucchanatthāya sampattamahājanassa lakkhaṇattayapariggahitaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā koṭisatasahassapurisānaṃ ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbājetvā arahatte patiṭṭhāpetvā caturaṅgike sannipāte pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: sobhitabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sobhito nāma satthā udapādīti sobhito nāma bodhisatto kappasatasahassādhikāni cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā devehi āyācito tusitapurato cavitvā sudhammanagare sudhammarājassa kule sudhammāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena sudhammuyyāne mātukucchito parisuddhavirājitaghanameghapaṭalato puṇṇacando viya nikkhamitvā dasavassasahassāni agāraṃ ajjhāvasitvā sattattiṃsanāṭakitthisahassānaṃ aggāya aggamahesiyā makhiladeviyā kucchismiṃ sīhakumāre nāma putte uppanne cattāri nimittāni disvā sañjātasaṃvego pāsādeyeva pabbajitvā tattheva ānāpānassatisamādhiṃ bhāvetvā cattāri jhānāni paṭilabhitvā sattāhaṃ tattheva padhānacariyaṃ acari.

before.title: sobhitabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tato makhilamahādeviyā dinnaṃ paramamadhuraṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā abhinikkhamanatthāya cittaṃ uppajjitvā “ayaṃ pāsādo alaṅkatapaṭiyatto mahājanassa passantasseva ākāsena gantvā bodhirukkhaṃ majjhe katvā pathaviyaṃ otaratu.

imā ca itthiyo mayi bodhimūle nisinne avuttā sayameva pāsādato nikkhamantū”ti adhiṭṭhahitvā saha cittuppādā pāsādo uppatitvā aṭṭhāsītihatthubbedhaṃ ujuvipulavaḍḍhakkhandhaṃ kusumapallavamakulasamalaṅkataṃ nāgarukkhaṃ majjhe katvā otaritvā bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā nāṭakitthiyo ca iddhiyā pakkamāpetvā rattiyā tīsu yāmesu tisso vijjā uppādetvā buddho udapādi.

before.title: sobhitabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatabhikkhū ahesunti uggato nāma rājā sunandavatīnagare sunandaṃ nāma vihāraṃ kāretvā buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa adāsi.
tasmiṃ dāne ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ koṭisataarahantānaṃ sannipāto.
tesaṃ majjhe sobhito bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: sobhitabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye navutikoṭiyoti puna mekhalānagare manussagaṇo gaṇārāmaṃ nāma vihāraṃ kāretvā buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa datvā saha sabbaparikkhārehi dānaṃ adāsi.
tadā tasmiṃ samāgame ehibhikkhubhāvena pabbajitānaṃ navutiarahantakoṭīnaṃ sannipāte pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: sobhitabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭiyoti yadā pana bhagavā dasasatanayana pure vassaṃ vasitvā pavāraṇāya suravarapurato otari.
tadā asītiyā arahantakoṭīhi saddhiṃ caturaṅgike sannipāte pavāresi.

before.title: anomadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāgetiādīsu anomadassī nāma bhagavā soḷasa asaṅkhyeyyāni kappasatasahassañca pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā devehi abhiyācito tato cavitvā candavatiyaṃ nāma rājadhāniyaṃ yasavā nāmassa rañño kule yasodharāya nāma aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena mātukucchito nikkhamitvā jātiyaṃ ākāsato sattaratanānaṃ patitattā anomānaṃ ratanānaṃ uppattihetubhūtattā “anomadassī”ti nāmaṃ labhitvā dasavassasahassāni sirī upasirī sirīvaḍḍhoti tīsu pāsādesu sukhaṃ anubhavitvā sirimāya nāma deviyā upavāṇe nāma putte jāte cattāri nimittāni disvā sivikāya mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā tiṃsajanakoṭiyā saddhiṃ pabbajitvā tehi parivuto dasamāse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya anupame nāma brāhmaṇagāme piṇḍāya caritvā anupamaseṭṭhidhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā anomena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā ajjunarukkhabodhiṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā aṭṭhatiṃsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā caturaṅgavīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhāya pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ viddhaṃsetvā tīsu yāmesu tisso vijjā uppādetvā buddho udapādi.

before.title: anomadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte bhikkhū aṭṭhasatasahassāni ahesunti soreyyanagare isidattassa rañño dhamme desiyamāne pasīditvā ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ arahantasatasahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: anomadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye sattāti rādhavatīnagare sundarindharassa nāma rañño dhamme desiyamāne ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ sattannaṃ arahantasatasahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: anomadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye chāti puna soreyyanagare yeva soreyyaraññā saha ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ channaṃ arahantasatasahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: padumo nāma satthā udapādīti anomadassissa bhagavato aparabhāge vassasatasahassāyukā manussā anukkamena parihāyitvā dasavassāyukā hutvā puna anukkamena vaḍḍhitvā asaṅkhyeyyāyukā hutvā puna parihāyamānā vassasatasahassāyukā ahesuṃ.
sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā campakanagare asamassa nāma rañño kule rūpādīhi asamattā asamāya nāma aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ aggahesi.
so dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena campakuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
jāte pana kumāre ākāsato sakalajambudīpe samuddapariyante padumavassaṃ nipati.
tenassa nāmaggahaṇadivase nāmaṃ gaṇhantā nemittakā ca ñātakā ca “mahāpadumakumāro”ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
nanduttara vasuttara yasuttarānāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: atha mahāsatto uttarāya nāma mahādeviyā rammakumāre nāma putte uppanne cattāri nimittāni disvā ājaññarathena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhami.

so tehi parivuto aṭṭha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya dhaññavatīnagare dhaññavatīseṭṭhissa dhītāya dhaññavatiyā nāma dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā mahāsālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye natthikena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā mahāsoṇabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā aṭṭhattiṃsahatthāyataṃ tiṇasantharakaṃ paññapetvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā caturaṅgavīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhāya mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā tīsu yāmesu tisso vijjā sacchikatvā aggappatto ahosīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassabhikkhū ahesunti yadā pana subhāvitatto nāma rājā padumassa buddhassa santike koṭisatasahassaparivuto ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajito.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye tīṇisatasahassānīti aparena samayena mahāpadumo munivasabho usabhavatīnagaraṃ upanissāya vassaṃ upagañchi.
tattha ca bahavo manussā pasannacittā pabbajiṃsu.
tato dasabalo tehi ca aññehi ca tīhi bhikkhusatasahassehi saddhiṃ visuddhipavāraṇaṃ pavāresi.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dvesatasahassānīti ye pana tattha na pabbajiṃsu.
te kathinānisaṃsaṃ sutvā pāṭipade pañcasu māsesu pañcānisaṃsadāyakaṃ kathinacīvaraṃ adaṃsu.
tato taṃ bhikkhū dhammasenāpatiṃ aggasāvakaṃ visālamatiṃ sālattheraṃ kathinatthāratthaṃ yācitvā kathinacīvaraṃ tassa adaṃsu.
therassa kathinacīvare kayiramāne bhikkhū sibbane sahāyakā ahesuṃ.
padumo nāma sammāsambuddho sucicchidde suttāni āvunitvā adāsi.
niṭṭhite pana cīvare bhagavā tīhi bhikkhusatasahassehi cārikaṃ pakkāmi.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: athāparena samayena sīhavikkantagāmī purisasīho viya buddhasīho gosiṅgasālavanasadise paramasurabhikusumaphalabhāravinamitasākhāviṭape vimalakamalakuvalayasamalaṅkate pavane vassāvāsaṃ upagañchi.
tasmiṃ viharantaṃ dasabalaṃ tathāgataṃ dhammarājaṃ buddhasiriyā virocamānaṃ disvā manussā tassa dhammaṃ sutvā pasīditvā ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajiṃsu.

before.title: padumabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: soṇarukkho nāma bodhīti ettha soṇarukkho nāma dīghavaṇṭarukkho.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge nārado nāma satthā udapādīti padumabuddhe pana parinibbute tassa sāsane ca antarahite vassasatasahassāyukā manussā anukkamena parihāyamānā dasavassāyukā hutvā puna vaḍḍhitvā asaṅkhyeyyāyukā hutvā parihāyamānā navutivassasahassāyukā ahesuṃ.

so cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni kappasatasahassañca pāramiyo pūretvā tusitabhavane nibbattitvā tato cavitvā dhaññavatīnagare vāsudevassa nāma rañño kule aggamahesiyā anomāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ aggahesi.
so dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena dhanañjayuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
nāmaggahaṇadivase pana nāmakaraṇe kayiramāne sakalajambudīpe manussānaṃ upabhogakkhamāni anurūpāni ābharaṇāni ākāsato kapparukkhādīhi nipatiṃsu.
tenassa narānaṃ arahāni ābharāṇāni adāsīti “nārado”ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: vijito vijitāvī vijitābhirāmoti tiṇṇaṃ utūnaṃ anucchavikā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

so vijitasenāya nāma deviyā nanduttare nāma kumāre jāte cattāri nimittāni disvā caturaṅginiyā senāya parivuto padasā uyyānaṃ gantvā sabbābharaṇāni omuñcitvā bhaṇḍārikassa hatthe datvā sayameva sakesamakuṭaṃ chinditvā gaganatale khipi.
taṃ sakko devarājā suvaṇṇacaṅkoṭakena paṭiggahetvā tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ netvā tiyojanubbedhaṃ sinerumuddhani sattaratanamayaṃ cetiyaṃ akāsi.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: mahāpuriso pana devadattāni kāsāyāni vatthāni paridahitvā tattheva uyyāne pabbaji.

so sattāhaṃ tattheva padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya vijitasenāya aggamahesiyā dinnaṃ pāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā tattheva uyyāne divāvihāraṃ katvā sudassanena nāma uyyānapālena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā mahāsoṇabodhiṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā aṭṭhapaṇṇāsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā tattha nisīditvā mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā tīsu yāmesu tisso vijjā uppādetvā sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭivijjhīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassabhikkhū ahesunti yadā pana bhagavā thullakoṭṭhikanagare bhaddasālo ca vijitamitto ca dve brāhmaṇasahākā amatapuraṃ gavesamānā parisati nisinnaṃ ativisāradaṃ nāradasammāsambuddhaṃ addasaṃsu.
te bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni disvā “ayaṃ loke vivaṭacchado sammāsambuddho”ti niṭṭhaṃ gantvā bhagavati sañjātasaddhā saparivārā bhagavato santike pabbajiṃsu.
tesu pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pattesu bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ koṭisatasahassamajjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye navutikoṭisahassānīti yasmiṃ samaye nārado sammāsambuddho ñātisamāgame attano paṇidhānato paṭṭhāya buddhavaṃsaṃ kathesi.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭisahassānīti yadā pana mahādoṇanāgarājassa vinayane pasanno verocano nāma nāgarājā bhabhaṅbhāya nadiyā tigāvutappamāṇaṃ sattaratanamayaṃ maṇḍapaṃ nimminitvā saparivāraṃ bhagavantaṃ tattha nisīdāpetvā saparivāro sajanapade attano dānaggassa dassanatthāya nimantetvā bhagavato saparivārassa mahādānaṃ adāsi.
bhojanāvasāne bhagavā mahābhabhaṅbhaṃ otārento viya anumodanaṃ akāsi.
tadā bhattānumodane dhammaṃ sutvā pasannānaṃ ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitānaṃ asītibhikkhusatasahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: nāradabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: mahāsoṇarukkho nāma bodhīti ettha soṇarukkho nāma khuddakasoṇo mahāsoṇoti dve soṇarukkhā honti.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: padumuttarabuddho nāma udapādīti nāradabuddhassa sāsanaṃ navutivassasahassāni pavattitvā antaradhāyi.
tato paraṃ kappānaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ buddhā loke na uppajjiṃsu.
tato kappesu ca asaṅkhyeyyesu vītivattesu ito kappasatasahassamatthake ekasmiṃ kappe eko vijitamāro ohitabhāro merusāro asaṃsāro sattasāro sabbalokuttaro padumuttaro nāma buddho loke udapādi.
sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā haṃsāvatīnagare ānandassa nāma rañño aggamahesiyā sujātāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ aggahesi.
dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena haṃsāvatuyyāne padumuttarakumāraṃ vijāyi.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: naravāhana yasavāhanavasavattināmakā tiṇṇaṃ utūnaṃ anucchavikā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.
vasudattādevippamukhānaṃ itthīnaṃ satasahassāni vīsatisahassāni ca paccupaṭṭhitāni ahesuṃ.
so vasudattāya deviyā putte uttarakumāre nāma uppanne cattāri nimittāni disvā “mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamissāmī”ti cintesi.
tassa cintitamatteva vasavattināmako pāsādo kumbhakāracakkaṃ viya bhamitvā ākāsaṃ abbhuggantvā ākāsena gantvā bodhirukkhaṃ majjhe karonto bhūmiyaṃ otari.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: mahāpuriso kira tato pāsādato otaritvā arahattaddhajabhūtāni kāsāyāni vatthāni devadattiyāni pārupitvā tattheva pabbaji.
mahāsattena saha gatāya parisāya ṭhapetvā itthiyo sabbe pabbajiṃsu.

mahāpuriso tehi saha sattāhaṃ padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya ujjenīnigame rucinandaseṭṭhidhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ katvā sāyanhasamaye sumittena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā salalabodhiṃ upagantvā taṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā aṭṭhattiṃsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā caturaṅgavīriyaṃ adhiṭṭhāya samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā paṭhame yāme pubbenivāsaṃ anussaritvā dutiye dibbacakkhuṃ visodhetvā tatiye paccayākāraṃ sammasitvā ānāpānacatutthajjhānato vuṭṭhāya pañcasu khandhesu abhinivisitvā udayabbayavasena samapaññāsalakkhaṇāni disvā yāva gotrabhuñāṇaṃ vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā ariyamaggena sakalabuddhaguṇe paṭivijjhitvā sabbabuddhāciṇṇaṃ “anekajātisaṃsāra”ntiādinā udānaṃ udānesi.
tadā kira dasasahassacakkavāḷabbhantaraṃ sakalampi alaṅkarontaṃ viya padumavassaṃ vassi.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhame koṭisatasahassabhikkhū ahesunti yadā pana satthā mithilanagare mithiluyyāne koṭisatasahassabhikkhugaṇamajjhe māghapuṇṇamāya puṇṇacandasadisavadano pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye vebhārapabbate navutikoṭisahassānīti yadā pana bhagavā vebhārapabbatakūṭe vassāvāsaṃ vasitvā pabbatasandassanatthaṃ āgatassa mahājanassa dhammaṃ desetvā navutikoṭisahassāni ehibhikkhubhāvena pabbājetvā tehi parivuto pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭisahassānīti puna bhagavati guṇavati tilokanāthe mahājanassa bandhanā pamokkhaṃ kurumāne janapadacārikaṃ caramāne asītikoṭisahassānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sannipāto ahosi.

before.title: padumuttarabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: salalarukkhoti ettha salalarukkho nāma sakkapādaparukkho yo “thaṅḥrhūḥ” iti vuccati.

before.title: sumedhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dve buddhā nibbattiṃsūti padumuttare pana sammāsambuddhe parinibbute sāsanepissa antarahite sattatikappasahassāni buddhā nuppajjiṃsu.
ito pana paṭṭhāya tiṃsakappasahassānaṃ matthake ekasmiṃ kappe sumedho sujāto cāti dve sammāsambuddhā nibbattiṃsu.

tattha sumedho nāma bodhisatto pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā sudassananagare sudattassa nāma rañño aggamahesiyā sudattāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena sudassanuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
tassa kira sucandana kañcana sirivaḍḍhananāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: sumedhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā sumanadeviyā punabbasumitte nāma putte jāte hatthiyānena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbajji.

so tehi parivuto addhamāsaṃ padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya nakulanigame nakulaseṭṭhidhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sirivaḍḍhena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā nimbabodhimūle vīsatihatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā abhisambodhiṃ pāpuṇīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: sumedhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye pana navutikoṭiyoti puna devakūṭe pabbate kathinatthate dutiye navutikoṭiyo ahesuṃ.

before.title: sumedhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭiyoti puna tatiye bhagavati cārikaṃ caramāne asītikoṭiyo ahesuṃ.

before.title: sumedhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so pana atimahantatāya mahānimbarukkhoti visesetvā vutto.

before.title: sujātabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge sujāto nāma satthā udapādīti tato tassa aparabhāge tasmiṃyeva maṇḍakappe anupubbena aparimāṇāyukesu sattesu anukkamena parihāyitvā navutivassasahassāyukesu jātesu sujāto nāma satthā loke udapādi.
sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā sumaṅgalanagare uggatassa nāma rañño kule pabhāvatiyā nāma aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena mātukucchito nikkhami.
sakalajambudīpe pana sabbasattānaṃ sukhaṃ janayanto jātoti “sujāto”tvevassa nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
sirī upasirī sirindocāti tassa tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: sujātabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā sirīnandāya nāma deviyā upasene nāma putte jāte haṃsavasabhaṃ [haṃsavahaṃ. buddhavaṃsa. ṭṭha. 240.] nāma varaturaṅgaṃ āruyha mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.
taṃ pana pabbajantaṃ manussānaṃ koṭi anupabbaji.

so tehi parivuto nava māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sirinandananagare sirinandanaseṭṭhissa dhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye sunandena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā veḷubodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tettiṃsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā sūriye dharamāneyeva samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sammāsambodhiṃ pāpuṇīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: sujātabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte saṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassāni ahesunti sudhammavatīnagare sudhammuyyāne āgatānaṃ manussānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā saṭṭhisatasahassāni ehibhikkhubhāvena pabbājetvā tesaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: sujātabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye paññāsanti tato paraṃ tidivorohaṇe bhagavato paññāsasatasahassānaṃ dutiyo sannipāto ahosi.

before.title: sujātabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye cattālīsanti “sudassanakumāro bhagavato santike pabbajitvā arahattaṃ patto”ti sutvā “mayampi pabbajissāmā”ti āgatāni cattālīsa purisasahassāni gahetvā sudassanatthero bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkami.
tesaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ desetvā ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbājetvā caturaṅgasamannāgate sannipāte pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: sujātabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: mahāveḷurukkho bodhīti ettha mahantatāya mahāveḷūti vuccati.mandachiddoti appachiddo.

before.title: piyadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: ito aṭṭhārasakappasatamatthake ekasmiṃ kappe piyadassī atthadassī dhammadassī cāti tayo buddhā nibbattiṃsūti yojanā.

tattha piyadassī nāma bhagavā pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā sudhañña vatīnagare sudattassa nāma rañño aggamahesiyā candādeviyā nāma mātu kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena varuṇuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
tassa nāmaggahaṇadivase lokassa piyānaṃ pāṭihāriyavisesānaṃ dassitattā “piyadassī”tveva nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
tassa kira sunimmalavimalagiribrahānāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: piyadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā vimalādeviyā kañcanaveḷe nāma putte uppanne ājaññarathena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto cha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya varuṇabrāhmaṇagāme vasabhabrāhmaṇassa dhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sujātena nāma ājīvakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā kakudhabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tepaññāsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭivijjhīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: piyadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhame koṭisatasahassā bhikkhū ahesunti sumaṅgalanagare pālito nāma rājaputto ca sabbadassī nāma purohitaputto cāti dve sahāyakā ahesuṃ.

te piyadassimhi sammāsambuddhe cārikaṃ carante “attano nagaraṃ sampatto”ti sutvā koṭisatasahassaparivārā paccuggamanaṃ katvā tassa dhammaṃ sutvā sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ datvā sattame divase bhagavato bhattānumodanāvasāne koṭisatasahassehi saddhiṃ pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.
tesaṃ pana majjhe bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: piyadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye navutikoṭiyoti athāparena samayena sudassanadevarājassa samāgame navutikoṭiyo arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

before.title: piyadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭiyoti puna doṇamukhassa nāma hatthissa vinayane asītikoṭiyo pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

before.title: atthadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge atthadassī nāma satthāti piyadassimhi sammāsambuddhe parinibbute tassa sāsane ca antarahite parihāyitvā vaḍḍhitvā aparimitāyukā manussā hutvā anukkamena parihāyitvā vassasatasahassāyukesu jātesu atthadassī nāma buddho loke uppajji.

so pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā paramasobhane sobhane nāma nagare sāgarassa nāma rañño sudassanāya nāma aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena sucindhanuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
mātukucchito mahāpurise nikkhantamatte kulaparamparāgatāni nihitāni mahānidhānāni dhanasāmikā paṭilabhiṃsūti tassa nāmaggahaṇadivase “atthadassī”ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

before.title: atthadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā visākhāya deviyā selakumāre nāma putte uppanne sudassanaṃ nāma assarājaṃ abhiruhitvā mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

tehi parivuto aṭṭha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sucinandāya nāma nāgiyā upahāratthāya ānītaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ mahājanena sandissamānasabbasarīrāya nāgiyā saha suvaṇṇapātiyā dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā mahārucirā nāma nāgarājena dinnā aṭṭha kusatiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā campakabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tepaññāsahatthāyāmavitthataṃ kusatiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā sammāsambodhiṃ pattoti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: atthadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhame aṭṭhanavutibhikkhusatasahassāni ahesunti sucandakanagare kira santo ca rājaputto upasanto ca purohitaputto sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhassa saṃghassa asadisaṃ mahādānaṃ datvā sattame divase sakalanagaravāsīhi manussehi saddhiṃ dhammakathaṃ suṇiṃsu.
tasmiṃ kira divase aṭṭhanavutisatasahassāni ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.
tāya parisāya majjhe bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: atthadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye aṭṭhāsītisatasahassānīti yadā pana bhagavā attano puttassa selattherassa dhammaṃ desento aṭṭhāsītisatasahassāni pasādetvā ehibhikkhubhāvena pabbājetvā arahattaṃ pāpetvā tesaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.
tathā tatiyeti puna mahāmaṅgalasamāgame māghapuṇṇamāyaṃ devamanussānaṃ dhammaṃ desento aṭṭhāsītisatasahassāni arahattaṃ pāpetvā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: atthadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: ettha ca idha aṭṭhasāliniyā nāma dhammasaṅgahaṭṭhakathāya ca tathā tatiyeti āgataṃ.
buddhavaṃsapāḷiyaṃ pana tadaṭṭhakathāyañca tatiye sannipāte aṭṭhasattatisahassānanti āgataṃ. evaṃ saṅkhyāvemattatāya bhinnepi attho bhinno na hoti.
tasmā idha mayaṃ saṃsanditvā na dassayissāma.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge dhammadassī nāma satthā udapādīti atthadassimhi sammāsambuddhe parinibbute antarakappe ca vītivatte aparimitāyukesu sattesu anupubbena parihāyitvā vassasatasahassāyukesu jātesu dhammadassī nāma satthā loke udapādi.
sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā saraṇanagare saraṇassa rañño aggamahesiyā sunandāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ aggahesi.
so dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena saraṇuyyāne mātukucchito pāvussakāle nikkhami.
mahāpurise pana mātukucchito nikkhantamatteyeva adhikaraṇabyavahārasatthapotthakesu adhammikā byavahārā sayameva antaradhāyiṃsu.
tassa kira araja viraja sudassananāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā vicikoḷideviyā puññavaḍḍhane nāma putte uppanne mahābhinikkhamanāya cittaṃ uppādesi.
saha cittuppādā sudassanapāsādo gaganatalaṃ abbhuggantvā caturaṅginiyā senāya parivuto bimbajālabodhisamīpeyeva otaritvā aṭṭhāsi.
mahāpuriso kira brahmunā upanītāni kāsāyāni gahetvā pabbajitvā pāsādato otaritvā avidūre aṭṭhāsi.
pāsādo puna ākāsena gantvā bodhirukkhaṃ antokatvā pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāsi.
itthiyopi saparivārā pāsādato otaritvā aḍḍhagāvutamattaṃ gantvā aṭṭhaṃsu.
tattha itthiyo ca tāsaṃ paricārikā ceṭikāyo ca ṭhapetvā sabbe manussā taṃ anupabbajiṃsu.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: atha dhammadassī bodhisatto sattāhaṃ padhānacariyaṃ caritvā vicikoḷi -deviyā dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā badaravane divāvihāraṃ katvā sāyanhasamaye sirivaḍḍhanena nāma yavapālakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā bimbajālabodhiṃ upagantvā tepaṇṇāsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā tattha sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭivijjhīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhame koṭisataṃ bhikkhūti yadā pana saraṇanagare vemātikabhātikaṃ padumakumāraṃ phussadevakumārañca saparivāre pabbājesi.
tasmiṃ antovasse pabbajitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ koṭisatasahassānaṃ majjhe visuddhipavāraṇaṃ pavāresi.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye satakoṭiyoti [sattatikoṭiyo. jā. ṭṭha. 1. 47.] puna bhagavato devalokato orohaṇe satakoṭīnaṃ dutiyo sannipāto ahosi.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭiyoti yadā pana sudassanārāme terasannaṃ dhutaguṇānaṃ ānisaṃse pakāsetvā hāritaṃ nāma sāvakaṃ etadagge ṭhapesi.
tadā asītikoṭīnaṃ majjhe bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: dhammadassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tenāha “yo bimbajāloti vuccatī”ti. [jā. ṭṭha. 5. 165] vakkhati ca alambusajātakaṭṭhakathāyaṃ “bimbajālakasañchannanti rattaṅkuravanena sañchanna”nti. [jā. ṭṭha. 5. 165.] vessantarajātakaṭṭhakathāyañca vakkhati “bimbajālanti rattaṅkurarukkha”nti. [jā. ṭṭha. 7. 263.] bimbajālarukkho ca nāma eko jamburukkhaviseso.
keci pana bimbajālarukkho nāma aggijālarukkhoti vadanti.

before.title: siddhatthabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: siddhattho nāma buddho udapādīti tato dhammadassimhi bhagavati parinibbute antarahite cassa sāsane tasmiñca kappe atīte kappasahasse ca sattasu kappasatesu ca chasu kappesu ca atikkantesu ito catunavutikappamatthake ekasmiṃ kappe ekova lokatthacaro adhigataparamattho siddhattho nāma bhagavā loke pāturahosi.

sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā vebhāranagare udenassa nāma rañño aggamahesiyā suphassāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena vīriyuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
jāte pana mahāpurise sabbesaṃ āraddhakammantā ca icchitā ca atthā siddhiṃ agamaṃsu.

before.title: siddhatthabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā somanassādeviyā putte anupamakumāre uppanne āsāḷhipuṇṇamiyaṃ suvaṇṇasivikāya nikkhamitvā vīriyuyyānaṃ gantvā pabbaji.

mahāpuriso kira tehi saddhiṃ dasa māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāyaṃ asadisabrāhmaṇagāme sunettāya nāma brāhmaṇakaññāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā badaravane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye varuṇena nāma yavapālena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā kaṇikārabodhiṃ upagantvā cattālīsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: siddhatthabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassaṃ bhikkhū ahesunti amaranagare sambalo ca sumitto ca dve bhātikā rajjaṃ kāresuṃ.
tadā bhagavā tattha gantvā tesaṃ ajjhāsayānurūpaṃ dhammaṃ desesi.
te tassa dhammakathaṃ sutvā sañjātasaddhā hutvā sabbeva pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.
bhagavā tesaṃ koṭisatasahassānaṃ khīṇāsavānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: siddhatthabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye navutikoṭiyoti vebhāranagare ñātisamāgame pabbajitānaṃ navutikoṭīnaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: siddhatthabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītikoṭiyoti sudassanavihāre sannipatitānaṃ asītikoṭīnaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: siddhatthabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: kaṇikārarukkho bodhīti ettha kaṇikāro nāma rukkhajātikavallijātikavasena duvidho.
tathā hi vakkhati vessantarajātakaṭṭhakathāyaṃ [jā. ṭṭha. 7. 314.] “kaṇikārāti vallikaṇikārā rukkhakaṇikārāti.
tathā hi vakkhati kuṇālajātakaṭṭhakathāyaṃ [jā. ṭṭha. 5. 452.] ”kaṇikārāti mahāpupphāti.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāgetiādīsu tassa pana siddhatthassa bhagavato aparabhāge eko kappo buddhasuñño ahosi.

ito dvānavutikappamatthake tisso, phussoti ekasmiṃ kappe dve buddhā nibbattiṃsūti attho.tattha tisso nāma mahāpuriso pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā khemakanagare janasandhassa nāma rañño aggamahesiyā padumāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena anomuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
tassa guhāsela, nārisaya, nisabhanāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā subhaddādeviyā putte ānandakumāre uppanne soṇuttaraṃ nāma turaṅgavaraṃ āruyha mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto aṭṭha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya vīranigame vīraseṭṭhissa dhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā salalavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye vijitasaṅgāmakena nāma yavapālena upanītā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā asanabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā cattālīsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā tattha pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭivijjhīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte bhikkhūnaṃ koṭisataṃ ahosīti yasavatīnagare kira antovassaṃ pabbajitānaṃ arahantānaṃ koṭisatehi parivuto bhagavā pavāresi.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye navutikoṭiyo(navutisatasahassāni?)ti ubhato sujātassa sujātassa nāma rañño nārivāhanakumāro nārivāhananagaraṃ anuppatte bhagavati lokanāthe saparivāro paccuggantvā dasabalaṃ sabhikkhusaṃghaṃ nimantetvā sattāhaṃ asadisadānaṃ datvā attano rajjaṃ puttassa niyyātetvā saparivāro bhagavato santike ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbaji.
tassa kira sā pabbajjā sabbadisāsu pākaṭā ahosi.
tasmā tato tato āgantvā nārivāhanakumāraṃ mahājano anupabbaji.
tadā tathāgato navutiyā bhikkhusatasahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītisatasahassānī1ti puna khemavatīnagare ñātisamāgame buddhavaṃsadhammakathaṃ sutvā asītisatasahassāni tassa santike pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dibbamandāravapadumapāricchattakapupphāni* ādāyāti bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā evaṃ cintesi “handāhaṃ mandāravapāricchattakādīhi dibbakusumehi bhagavantaṃ pūjessāmī”ti.

evaṃ so cintetvā iddhiyā saggalokaṃ gantvā cittalatāvanaṃ pavisitvā padumapāricchattakamandāravādīhi dibbakusumehi ratanamayaṃ caṅkoṭakaṃ gāvutappamāṇaṃ pūretvā gahetvā gaganatalena āgantvā tehi bhagavantaṃ pūjesīti.

before.title: tissabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tena vakkhati asītinipātaṭṭhakathāyaṃ [piyakāti setapupphā. jā. ṭṭha. 5. 452] kuṇālajātakasaṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ “piyakāti somapupphā”ti.

before.title: phussabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge phusso nāma satthā udapādīti tassa tissassa bhagavato aparabhāge anukkamena parihāyitvā puna vaḍḍhitvā aparimitāyukā hutvā anupubbena parihāyitvā navutivassasahassāyukesu jātesu tasmiṃyeva kappe phusso nāma satthā loke uppajji.

sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā kāsikanagare jayasenarañño aggamahesiyā sirimāya nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena sirimuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
tassa kira garuḷapakkha,haṃsa,suvaṇṇabhāranāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: phussabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā kisāgotamiyā anupame nāma tanaye uppanne alaṅkatagajavarakkhandhagato mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto cha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā tato gaṇaṃ pahāya sattāhaṃ ekakova vasitvā visākhapuṇṇamāya aññatare nagare aññatarassa seṭṭhino dhītāya sirivaḍḍhāya nāma dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā siṃsapāvane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye sirivaḍḍhena nāma upāsakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā āmalakabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paṭivijjhīti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: phussabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte saṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassāni ahesunti aparena samayena kaṇṇakujjanagare surakkhito rājaputto ca dhammasenakumāro purohitaputto ca phusse sammāsambuddhe attano nagaraṃ sampatte saṭṭhiyā purisasatasahassehi saddhiṃ paccuggantvā vanditvā nimantetvā sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ datvā dasabalassa dhammakathaṃ sutvā bhagavati pasīditvā te saparivārā pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

before.title: phussabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye paṇṇāsāti puna kāsinagare ñātisamāgame buddhavaṃsaṃ desesi.
taṃ sutvā paññāsasatasahassāni ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

before.title: phussabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye dvattiṃsāti puna mahāmaṅgalasamāgame maṅgalakathaṃ sutvā cattālīsapurisasatasahassāni pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

before.title: phussabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sīlapāramiñca puresīti visesato atirekavasena sīlapāramipūraṇaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
tadāpi hi bodhisatto dasa pāramiyo pūretiyevāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge ito ekanavutikappe vipassī nāma bhagavā udapādīti phussabuddhassa aparabhāge anantarakappe tasmiñca kappe vītivatte ito ekanavutikappe vipassī nāma satthā loke udapādi.
sopi pāramiyo pūretvā tusitabhavane nibbattitvā tato cavitvā bandhumatīnagare bandhumato nāma rañño aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena mātukucchito nikkhami.
nāmaggahaṇadivase panassa lakkhaṇapāṭhakā ñātakā ca divā ca rattiñca antarā nimmisasañjanītandhakāravigahena visuddhaṃ passanti.
vivaṭehi vā akkhīhi passatīti “vipassī”ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
nanda sunanda sirimānāmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sudassanādevippamukhānaṃ itthīnaṃ satasahassaṃ vīsati ca sahassāni paccupaṭṭhitāni ahesuṃ.
so cattāri nimittāni disvā sudassanāya nāma deviyā samavaṭṭakkhandhe nāma tanaye jāte ājaññarathena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto aṭṭhamāsaṃ padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sudassanaseṭṭhidhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sujātena nāma yavapālakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā pāṭalibodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ paṭivijjhīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ ahosīti kheme migadāye bhagavantaṃ dve ca aggasāvake anupabbajitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aṭṭhasaṭṭhisatasahassānaṃ majjhe bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye ekasatasahassanti puna yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ disvā pabbajitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ satasahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye asītisahassānīti yadā pana vipassissa vemātika tayo bhātaro paccantaṃ vūpasametvā bhagavato upaṭṭhānakiriyāya laddhavarā hutvā attano nagaraṃ netvā upagantvā tassa dhammaṃ sutvā pabbajiṃsu.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: kuverayakkhassa pana akkhi- sadisattā “kuverasakkhī”ti vuccatīti vadanti lokiyāti.
taṃdivasameva kaṇṇikāya baddhehi viya pupphehi paramasurabhigandhehi mūlato paṭṭhāya sabbasañchannā ahosi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dve buddhā ahesunti vipassissa aparabhāge antarahite ca tasmiṃ kappe tato paraṃ ekūnasaṭṭhiyā kappesu buddhā loke na uppajjiṃsu.
ito pana ekattiṃsakappe sikhī ca vessabhū cāti dve buddhā loke uppajjiṃsu.

tattha sikhī pana bhagavā pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā aruṇavatīnagare aruṇavato nāma rañño aggamahesiyā pabhāvatiyā nāma deviyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena nisabhuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
nemittikā panassa nāmaṃ karontā uṇhīsassa sikhā viya uggatattā “sikhī”ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā sabbakāmadeviyā atule nāma putte uppanne hatthiyānena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto aṭṭha māsaṃ padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya gaṇaṃ pahāya sudassananigame piyadassiseṭṭhino dhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā taruṇavaruṇavane [taruṇakhadiravane. buddhavaṃsa. ṭṭha. 285.] divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā anomadassinā nāma tāpasena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā puṇḍarikabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā catuvīsatihatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sammāsambodhiṃ pāpuṇīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte bhikkhusatasahassaṃ ahosīti abhibhunā ca sambhavena ca rājaputtena saddhiṃ pabbajitānaṃ arahantānaṃ satasahassasaṅkhyānaṃ majjhe nisīditvā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye asītisahassānīti aruṇavatīnagare ñātisamāgame pabbajitānaṃ asītiyā bhikkhusahassānaṃ majjhe nisīditvā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye sattatisahassānīti dhanañcayanagare dhanapālakanāgavinayanasamaye pabbajitānaṃ sattatiyā bhikkhusahassānaṃ majjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so kira taṃdivasameva paṇṇāsaratanakkhandho hutvā abbhuggato.
so dibbehi gandhehi pupphehi ca sañchanno ahosi.
tassa ekapassato taruṇaphalāni ekato majjhimāni ekato nātipakkāni ekato pakkhittadibbojāni viya surasāni vaṇṇagandharasasampannāni tato tato olambanti.
evaṃ dasasahassicakkavāḷesu pupphūpagā rukkhā pupphehi phalūpagā rukkhā phalehi paṭimaṇḍitā ahesuṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge vessabhū nāma satthā udapādīti sikhissa pana bhagavato aparabhāge antarahite cassa sāsane sattativassasahassāyukā manussā anukkamena parihāyitvā dasavassāyukā hutvā puna vaḍḍhitvā aparimitāyukā hutvā anukkamena parihāyitvā saṭṭhivassasahassāyukā ahesuṃ.

so pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā anomanagare suppatītassa nāma rañño aggamahesiyā yasavatiyā nāma kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena anupamuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā sucittāya nāma deviyā suppabuddhe nāma kumāre uppanne suvaṇṇasivikāya uyyānadassanatthāya gantvā devadattāni kāsāyāni gahetvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto cha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sucittanigame sandissamānasarīrāya sirivaḍḍhanāya nāma devadhītāya dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā sālavane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye narindanāgarājena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā sālabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā cattālīsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā abhisambodhiṃ pāpuṇīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: paṭhamasannipāte asītibhikkhusahassāni ahesunti soṇuttarānaṃ dvinnaṃ aggasāvakānaṃ samāgame pabbajitānaṃ asītiyā arahantasahassānaṃ majjhe māghapuṇṇamāyaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.
visadisasaṅkhyābhāve pana heṭṭhā vuttanayena sanniṭṭhānaṃ avagantabbaṃ.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: dutiye sattatīti yadā pana bhagavatā saha pabbajitā sattatisahassabhikkhū gaṇato ohīnasamaye pakkantā.
te bhagavato dhammacakkappavattiṃ sutvā soreyyaṃ nāma nagaraṃ āgantvā bhagavantaṃ addasaṃsu.
tesaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ desetvā sabbeva te ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbājetvā caturaṅgasamannāgatāya parisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tatiye saṭṭhīti yadā pana nārivāhananagare upasanto nāma rājaputto rajjaṃ kāresi.
sopi ca saparivāro bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ katvā nimantetvā mahādānaṃ datvā dhammaṃ sutvā pasannahadayo pabbaji.

before.title: vipassībuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sālasaddo pana rukkhasāmaññepi sajjarukkhepi vanappatirukkhepi vattati.

before.title: kakusandhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: amhākaṃ bhagavāti vessabhumhi parinibbute tasmiṃ pana kappe atikkante ekūnatiṃsakappesu buddhā nuppajjiṃsu.
imasmiṃ pana bhaddakappe kakusandho koṇāgamano kassapo amhākaṃ sambuddhoti cattāro buddhā nibbattiṃsu.

tattha kakusandho nāma bhagavā pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā khemavatīnagare khemaṅkararañño atthadhammānusāsakassa aggidattassa nāma purohitassa visākhāyā nāma brāhmaṇiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ aggahesi.
yadā pana khattiyā brāhmaṇe sakkaronti pūjenti mānenti garuṃ karonti.
yadā pana brāhmaṇā khattiye sakkaronti pūjenti mānenti garuṃ karonti.
tadā kira brāhmaṇā khattiyehi sakkarīyanti pūjīyanti mānīyanti garuṃ karīyanti.

before.title: kakusandhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tato dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena khemavatuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
tassa kira kāma, kāmavaṇṇa, kāmasuddhināmakā tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.
so cattāri nimittāni disvā rociniyā brāhmaṇiyā uttare nāma kumāre uppanne ājaññarathena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto aṭṭha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sucirindhanigame vajirindhabrāhmaṇassa dhītuyā dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā khadiravane divāvihāraṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamaye subhaddena nāma yavapālakena dinnā aṭṭhatiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā sirīsabodhiṃ upasaṅkamitvā catuttiṃsahatthavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā sammāsambodhiṃ sampattoti.

before.title: kakusandhabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: ekova sāvakasannipātoti kaṇṇakujjanagare isipatane migadāye attanā saha pabbajitehi cattālīsāya arahantasahassehi parivuto māghapuṇṇamāyaṃ bhagavā pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: koṇāgamanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge koṇāgamano nāma satthā udapādīti tassa kakusandhassa bhagavato aparabhāge tassa ca sāsane antarahite sattesu tiṃsavassasahassāyukesu jātesu koṇāgamano nāma satthā loke udapādi.
ettha pana āhu anupubbena parihīnasadisaṃ kataṃ.
imasmiṃ kappe kakusandho bhagavā cattālīsavassasahassāyukakāle nibbatto.
taṃ pana āyu parihāyamānaṃ dasavassakālaṃ patvā puna asaṅkhyeyyaṃ patvā tato parihāyamānaṃ tiṃsavassasahassāyukakāle ṭhitaṃ.
tadā koṇāgamano bhagavā loke uppannoti veditabbo.

before.title: koṇāgamanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā sobhavatīnagare yaññadattassa nāma brāhmaṇassa uttarāya nāma brāhmaṇiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena subhavatīuyyāne mātukucchito nikkhami.
jāyamāne pana tasmiṃ sakalajambudīpe devo kanakavassaṃ vassi.
tenassa kanakāgamanassa kāraṇattā “kanakāgamano”ti tassa nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
taṃ panassa nāmaṃ anukkamena vipariṇāmaṃ hutvā “koṇāgamano”ti nāmaṃ jātaṃ.
ettha ca ka-kāragatassa a-kārassa okārādesaṃ katvā na-kārassa ca ṇa-kārādesaṃ katvā ekassa ka-kārassa lopaṃ katvā niruttinayena vohārasiddhi veditabbā.
so pana tīṇi vassasahassāni agāraṃ ajjhāvasi.

before.title: koṇāgamanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā rucigattāya brāhmaṇiyā satthavāhe nāma putte uppanne hatthivāhanena mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji.

so tehi parivuto cha māse padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāyaṃ aggisonabrāhmaṇassa dhītuyā aggisonabrāhmaṇakumāriyā dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā khadiravane divāvihāraṃ katvā sāyanhasamaye jaṭātindukena nāma yavapālena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā udumbarabodhiṃ upagantvā vīsatihatthavitthataṃ tiṇa- santharaṃ santharitvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā samāraṃ mārabalaṃ vidhamitvā sammāsambodhiṃ sampattoti veditabbo.

before.title: koṇāgamanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tiṃsabhikkhusahassāni ahesunti surindavatīnagare surindavatuyyāne viharanto bhiyyasassa rājaputtassa ca uttarassa ca rājaputtassa dvinnampi tiṃsasahassaparivārānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā sabbeva te ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbājetvā tesaṃ majjhe māghapuṇṇamāyaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: koṇāgamanabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassapi sikhissa viya bhagavato udumbararukkhassa vibhavo daṭṭhabbo.

before.title: kassapabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tassa aparabhāge kassapo nāma satthā udapādīti tassa koṇāgamanassa bhagavato aparabhāge tassa ca sāsane antarahite tiṃsavassasahassāyukā sattā anupubbena parihāyitvā dasavassāyukā hutvā puna vaḍḍhitvā aparimitāyukā hutvā puna anupubbena parihāyitvā vīsativassasahassāyukesu sattesu kassapo nāma satthā loke udapādi.

so pāramiyo pūretvā tusitapure nibbattitvā tato cavitvā bārāṇasīnagare brahmadattassa nāma brāhmaṇassa dhanavatiyā nāma brāhmaṇiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena isipatane migadāye mātukucchito nikkhami.
haṃsāvā yasavā sirinandoti tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ.

before.title: kassapabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: so cattāri nimittāni disvā sunandāya brāhmaṇiyā vijitasene nāma putte uppanne uppannasaṃvego “mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamissāmī”ti cintitakkhaṇeyeva pāsādo kulālacakkamiva bhamitvā gaganatalaṃ abbhuggantvā nigrodhabodhiṃ majjhe katvā bhūmiyaṃ otaritvā patiṭṭhahi.
atha pathaviyaṃ mahāsatto patiṭṭhahitvā devadattaṃ arahattaddhajaṃ ādāya pabbaji.
tassa nāṭakitthiyo pāsādā otaritvā aḍḍhagāvutaṃ maggaṃ gantvā saparivārā sannivāsaṃ katvā nisīdiṃsu.
tato itthiparicārike ṭhapetvā samāgatā sabbe pabbajiṃsu.

before.title: kassapabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: mahāpuriso kira sattāhaṃ tehi parivuto padhānacariyaṃ caritvā visākhapuṇṇamāya sunandāya nāma brāhmaṇiyā dinnaṃ madhupāyāsaṃ paribhuñjitvā khadiravane divāvihāraṃ katvā sāyanhasamaye somena nāma yavapālakena dinnā aṭṭha tiṇamuṭṭhiyo gahetvā nigrodhabodhiṃ upagantvā pannarasahatthāyāmavitthataṃ tiṇasantharaṃ santharitvā tattha nisīditvā abhisambodhiṃ sampāpuṇīti.

before.title: kassapabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: vīsatibhikkhusahassāni ahesunti bārāṇasīnagare tisso nāma purohitaputto kassapassa bodhisattassa sarīre lakkhaṇasampattiṃ disvā pituno bhāsato sutvā “nissaṃsayaṃ eso mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā buddho bhavissati.
etassāhaṃ santike pabbajitvā saṃsāradukkhato muccissāmī”ti cintetvā himavantaṃ gantvā tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbaji.
so aparabhāge “kassapakumāro nikkhamitvā abhisambodhiṃ anuppatto”ti sutvā saparivāro āgantvā kassapassa bhagavato santike saparivāro ehibhikkhupabbajjāya pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
tasmiṃ samāgame kassapo bhagavā māghapuṇṇamāyaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisi.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tasmāti yasmā tesaṃ santikā bodhisattassa byākaraṇaṃ natthi.
tasmā te tayo buddhā idha na dassitāti attho.
manussattanti manussattabhāveyeva ṭhatvā buddhattaṃ patthentassa patthanā samijjhati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: liṅgasampattīti manussattabhāve pavattamānassāpi purisaliṅge ṭhitasseva patthanā samijjhati.
na itthiyā vā paṇḍakanapuṃsakaübhatobyañjanakānaṃ vā samijjhati.
yaṃ itthī arahaṃ assa sammāsambuddho”ti vitthāro. [aṃ. 1. 30.] tasmā itthiliṅge ṭhitassa manussajātikassāpi patthanā na samijjhati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: hetūti purisassāpi tasmiṃ attabhāve arahattappattiyā hetusampannasseva patthanā samijjhati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: parinibbute bhagavati cetiyassa santike vā bodhirukkhamūle vā paṭimāya vā paccekabuddha,buddhasāvakānaṃ vā santike patthanā na samijjhati.
bhabbābhabbake ñatvā kammavipākaparicchedakañāṇena paricchinditvā byākātuṃ asamatthatā.
tasmā buddhassa santike yeva patthanā samijjhati.
satthāradassananti ca samāsagatanāme pare satthūsaddādīnaṃ anto ārattamāpajjatīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: pabbajjāti buddhassa bhagavato santike patthentassāpi kammakiriyavādīsu tāpasesu vā bhikkhūsu vā pabbajitasseva patthanā samijjhati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: adhikāroti guṇasampannenāpi yena attano jīvitaṃ buddhānaṃ pariccattaṃ hoti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: chandatāti abhinīhārasampannassāpi yassa buddhakārakadhammānaṃ atthāya mahanto chando vāyāmo ca ussāho ca pariyeṭṭhi ca.
tatridaṃ chandamahantatāya opammaṃ -- sace hi evamassa yo pana sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ ekodakībhūtaṃ attano bāhubalena uttaritvā pāraṃ gantuṃ samattho.
yo pana imaṃ attano dukkaraṃ na maññati “ahaṃ imaṃ uttaritvā pāraṃ gamissāmī”ti evaṃ mahatā chandena ussāhena sampannāgato hoti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: sumedhapaṇḍito pana ime aṭṭha dhamme samodhānetvāva buddhabhāvāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipajji.
tena vuttaṃ “ime aṭṭha dhamme samodhānetvā”ti ādi.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tattha ca aggijālānaṃ vā sattānaṃ vā rukkhassa vā antaraṃ natthi.
tassa hi puratthimabhittito jālā uṭṭhitā saṃsibbamānā yojanasataṃ gantvā pacchimabhittiṃ vinivijjhitvā parato yojanasataṃ gacchati.
imesaṃ catunnaṃ jālānaṃ vemajjhe nibbatto devadatto.
dve pādā yāva gopphakā lohapathaviṃ paviṭṭhā.
dve hatthā yāva maṇibandhā lohabhittiyo paviṭṭhā.
adhobhāgena ekaṃ lohasūlaṃ pavisitvā kāyaṃ vinivijjhantaṃ chadane paviṭṭhaṃ.
pācīnabhittito nikkhantasūlaṃ hadayaṃ vinivijjhitvā pacchimabhittiṃ paviṭṭhaṃ.
uttarabhittito nikkhantasūlaṃ phāsukā vinivijjhitvā dakkhiṇabhittiṃ paviṭṭhaṃ.
niccakāle tathāgatamhi aparaddhattā niccalova hutvā paccatīti kammasarikkhatāya ediso jāto.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: abbhantare panassa yojanasatike ṭhāne nāḷiyaṃ koṭṭetvā puritapiṭṭhaṃ viya sattā nirantarā.
gacchantānaṃ ṭhitānaṃ nisinnānaṃ nipajjamānānaṃ anto natthi.
gacchante vā ṭhite vā nisinne vā nipanne vā aññamaññaṃ na bādhanti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: kāyadvāre pana cha upekkhāsahagatāni cittāni uppajjanti.
evaṃ santepi yathā jivhagge cha madhubindūni ṭhapetvā ekasmiṃ tambalohabindumhi ṭhapite anudahanabalavatāya tadeva paññāyati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: apare pana evaṃ vadanti “natthi sukhassa vīci leso etthāti avīci.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: ettha ca taraṅgavācako vīcisaddo ādikkhare dīgho icchitabbo.
tena ca taraṅgatthavācakena vīcisaddena samānasutikoyeva vīcisaddo appatthavācako sukhatthavācako vā hoti, samānasutikavasena atthuddhāre dassitattā.
yaṃ pana saddanītiyaṃ mānavasaddassa muddhajadantajakkharavasena asamānasutikassa atthuddhāradassanaṃ vuttaṃ.
teneva pana appatthasukhatthavācakena vīcisaddena nipphannattā avīcisaddo nirayavācako ādidīghavasena icchitabboti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tiṇṇaṃ tiṇṇañhi cakkavāḷānaṃ antare ekeko lokantarikanirayo nāma hoti aṭṭha yojanasahassapamāṇo.
te vagguliyo viya pabbatapāde dīghaputhulehi nakhehi laggitvā avaṃsirā olambanti.
tadā “bhakkho no laddho”ti maññamānā tattha byāvaṭā viparivattitvā lokasandhārake udake patanti.
sītavāte paharantepi pakkamadhukaphalāni viya chijjitvā udake patanti.
patitamattāva accantakhārena sītodakena chinnacammanhārumaṃsaaṭṭhīhi bhijjamānehi tatta tele patitapiṭṭhapiṇḍi viya paṭapaṭāyamānā viliyantīti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: te hi dve tīṇi buddhantarāni kiñcideva āmisaṃ hatthena gahetvā mukhe pakkhipantā nāma na honti.
tesaṃ kira tigāvuto attabhāvo appamaṃsalohito purāṇapaṇṇasadiso kakkaṭakānaṃ viya akkhīni nikkhamitvā matthake tiṭṭhanti.
te hi dve tīṇi buddhantarāni hadayatemanamattaṃ udakabinduṃ laddhuṃ na sakkonti.
pānīyaṃ pivissāmāti nadīgatānampi tesaṃ nadī vālikātalaṃ sampajjati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: duggatiyaṃ upapajjantāpi khuddakā pāṇā na hontīti attho.
mūgapakkhikāti avissaṭṭhavācā virahakathā vācaṃ nicchāretuṃ asamatthā na bhavantīti attho.
atha vā ubhato pavattaṃ byañjanaṃ etesanti viggaho bhinnādhikaraṇabahubbīhisamāsoyaṃ.
bodhiyāti buddhatthāya niyatā narā pañcavidhehi ānantariyakammehi muttāti attho.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: hetu nāma na vijjatīti suddhāvāsesu devesu uppajjanahetu nāma na vijjati.
sassatadiṭṭhiyā vā ucchedadiṭṭhiyā ca visaṃyuttā anālayā hutvāti attho.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: adhigantvāti ettha gamu-saddo adhipubbattā atthātisayayogato ca lābhe vattati.
akittibrāhmaṇakāletiādīsu tesaṃ tesaṃ atthuppatti tesu tesu jātakesu āvi bhavissati.
cutipaṭisandhivasena pana ekekaparicchinnabhavatāya bahuvacanaṃ upapannaṃ hoti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ dānapāramidānaüpapāramitāya pūritaattabhāve ekadesamattena dassetvā idāni dānaparamatthapāramitāya pūritaattabhāve ekadeseneva dassetuṃ vuttaṃ “ekantena panassā”tiādi.
sabbe mānusā hatāpi cittassa aññathā saṃkocanabhāvo natthīti attho.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: idāni pana saṅkheparucitāya paramatthapāramitāya pūritattabhāve yeva dassetuṃ “khantivādijātake”ti ādimāha.
acetanaṃva koṭṭenteti acetane anupādiṇṇake pathavīpabbatarukkhādayo viya tikhiṇena parasunā mamaṃ koṭṭente kāsirāje na kuppāmīti attho.
mātāpitā na me dessāti mātāpitaro me na appiyāti attho.
bhīrutāyoge hi nissakkatthe sāmivacanaṃ upayogavacanaṃ karaṇavacanaṃ vā icchanti saddakovidā.
garū pana bhayappayoge vibhattivipallāsavasena pañcamiyatthaṃ bhaṇanti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tīṇeva pāḷiyaṃ honti. na tu sambhoti pañcamī”ti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: etthāha nanu ca pāḷiyampi 'yato khemaṃ tato bhaya'nti bhīrutāyoge pañcamīpayogopi dissatīti?
taṃ vaṇṇavisayā aññā tādisī pāḷi dissati.
apica “corā bhayaṃ jāyatī”ti etthāpi jayatisaddavaseneva nissakkavacanaṃ avassaṃ labbhatīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: pageva aññaṃ pana vatthunti pi-saddassa garahattho veditabbo.
nāmampi samānaṃ āyapaccayavasena dhātupaṭirūpakattā dhātu viyāti nāmadhātūti vuccati.
gāmadārakesūti bhāvenabhāvalakkhaṇatthe bhummavacanaṃ “bhikkhūsu bhojīyamānesu gato”tiādīsu “bhikkhūsū”ti ādipade viya.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti -- yassa kriyāya aññassa kriyāya lakkhaṇaṃ sallakkhaṇaṃ jānanaṃ bhavati.

tadatthajotakamidaṃ suttaṃ -- “atha kho māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante ānande yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamī”ti tattha mārassa bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamanakriyā āyasmato ānandassa bhagavato santikā pakkamanakriyāya lakkhiyati.
tasmā tasmiṃ pakkamanakriyāvati āyasmante ānande sattamīvibhatti bhavati.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: imasmiṃ ṭhāne yebhuyyavasena samānādhikaraṇabhūte bhāvavācakapade vijjamāneyeva samānādhikaraṇapadavati pade bhāvasattamīti vohāro pavattati.
garū pana katthaci ṭhāne samānādhikaraṇabhūtaṃ bhāvavācakapadaṃ avijjamānampi āharitvā asamānādhikaraṇapadaṃ samānādhikaraṇapadaṃ katvā tattha bhāvasattamīti voharanti.
tathā hi te “sati, gamyamāne, vattabbe”ti ca ādīni yathārahaṃ ajjhāharanti.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: tattha siyā -- yadi “bhikkhūsu bhojiyamānesū”ti ettha 'bhikkhūsū' ti ayaṃ bhāvavasena laddhā sattamīti bhāvasattamī nāma siyā.
'bhojiyamānesū'ti esā pana katarā nāma sattamī siyā”ti?
nanu esāyeva bhāve vattamānā sattamī bhāvasattamī ti anvatthavasena vattabbāti?
tathāpi bhāvasattamīti vohāro tādisesu porāṇehi na āropito.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: buddhaṃ vandāma gotama”nti ettha buddhanti “kammatthe dutiyā”ti lakkhaṇena siddhaṃ.
tathā bhāvasattamivisayepi “kālabhāvesu cā”ti lakkhaṇena samānādhikaraṇapadesu vibhattuppatti sijjhati.
buddhaṃ vandāma gotama”ntiādīsu dve kammāni, tīṇi kammāni, cattāri kammānītiādinā bahūni kammāni na icchitabbāni.
atha kho ekameva kammaṃ icchitabbaṃ, bahūhipi padehi ekassevatthassa kathitattā.
evameva “bhikkhūsu bhojiyamānesu, acirapakkante āyasmante ānande”ti ca ādīsupi dve bhāvasattamiyo, tisso bhāvasattamiyo, catasso bhāvasattamiyotiādinā bahū bhāvasattamiyo na icchitabbā.
atha kho ekāyeva bhāvasattamī icchitabbā, bahūhipi padehi ekassevatthassa kathitattā.

before.title: gotamabuddhavaṃsavaṇṇanā
lines: niṭṭhubhanādīhiti kheḷuppādanādīhi dukkhaṃ, celamālāgandhūpahārādīhi [niṭṭhubhanādīhi ceva mālagandhupahārādīhi ca.(chaṭṭha)] sukhanti yathālābhayojanā daṭṭhabbā.
atha vā cetanāsaddo cittapariyāyo, abyāpāro acetano suññotiādīsu viya.
sāpi pathavī mayhaṃ dānabalā dānabalena dānassa ānubhāvena sattakkhattuṃ pakampathāti sambandho.
pathaviṃ kampituṃ samatthāni mahāpuññāni karitvāti attho.
so hi tussanti modanti devā etthāti tussitāti vuccati.
tassa pana divādigaṇikattā sakāradvayasaṃyogavasena rūpasiddhi bhavati.
tattha bodhisatto aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhitvā yāvatāyukaṃ dibbasampattiṃ anubhavanto manussagaṇanāya saṭṭhivassasatasahassādhikāni sattapaññāsakoṭiyo paripūresīti.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: lokabyūhā nāmāti ettha lokatthaṃ visesena ūhanti vitakkentīti lokabyūhā.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: devatānaṃ paṭiññaṃ adatvāvāti devatānaṃ paṭiññaṃ paṭhamameva adatvāva.
tilakkhaṇamuttā nāma natthīti buddhānaṃ jātakadesanāpi catusaccakūṭena nigametvā desitā.
neva sotabbaṃ na saddhātabbaṃ maññantīti vaḍḍhitāyukānaṃ sattānaṃ dīghāyukatāya upacchedakakammādinā antarāmaraṇassa ca appakatāya aniccalakkhaṇaṃ paṭicchannaṃ hoti.
majjhimapadesanti majjhānaṃ parisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ nivāsanaṭṭhābhūto padesoti majjhimapadeso.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: kiṃ pana nandanavanaṃ nāma tāvatiṃsabhavane yeva atthīti?
sabbadevalokesu hīti na nandanavanaṃ nāma uyyānaṃ tāvatiṃsabhavaneyeva atthi.
atha kho sabbesu chasu kāmāvacaradevalokesupi atthiyevāti attho.
pubbe katakusalakammokāsaṃ sārayamānāti pubbe katassa kusalakammassa vipākassa dinnokāsaṃ patthayamānā vicarantīti attho.
tadā pana ākārantapulliṅgoti gahetabbo, yathā ātumāiccādayo.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: dvinnaṃ pana nagarānanti kapilavatthussa devadahassa ca imesaṃ dvinnaṃ nagarānaṃ.
lumbinīvanaṃ nāmāti lumbati addati hiṃsati vātātapādayo etthāti lumbinīti evaṃ nāmakaṃ vanaṃ.
pañcavaṇṇā bhamaragaṇāti pañcavaṇṇānaṃ pupphānaṃ vaṇṇobhāsena paññāyamānattā pañcavaṇṇā aligaṇā.
amaccā deviṃ gahetvā pavisiṃsūti amaccā rañño ārocetvā deviṃ gahetvā taṃ lumbinīvanaṃ pavisiṃsu.
sā maṅgalasālamūlaṃ gantvāti sā devī maṅgalasajjarukkhamūlaṃ gantvā ujusamavaṭṭakkhandhassa pupphaphalapallavasamalaṅkatassa sākhaṃ sayaṃ gaṇhitukāmā ahosi.
sālasākhā suseditavettaggaṃ viya onamitvā deviyā hatthagataṃ upagatāti sā sālasākhā agginā tāpitavettaggaṃ viya sayameva olambamānā hutvā tassā deviyā karatalasamīpaṃ upagatāti attho.

sā hatthaṃ pasāretvā sālasākhaṃ aggahesīti atha sā devī hatthaṃ pasāretvā taṃ sālasākhaṃ tambatuṅganakhujjalena kamaladalavattivaṭṭaṅgulinā samalaṅkatena navakanakakaṭavalayasobhinā dakkhiṇena paramaratikarena karena aggahesi.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tāvadeva cassā kammajavātā caliṃsūti sā taṃ sālasākhaṃ gahetvā ṭhitāyeva asitajaladharavivaragatā bālacandalekhā viya ca aciraṭṭhitikā accipabhā viya ca nandanavanajātā devī viya ca devī virocittha.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: anekāni cakkavāḷasahassāni ekaṅgaṇāni ahesunti anekāni cakkavāḷasahassāni cakkhupathe āvaraṇassa natthitāya ekaṅgaṇāni ahesuṃ.
mahājanassa pana ākāsena gacchanto viya ca alaṅkatapaṭiyatto viya ca soḷasavassuddesiko viya ca paññāyati.
sīhanādaṃ nadīti sīhassa nādaṃ viya nādaṃ nadi.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ettha -- siyā yā panesā 'nada-abyattasadde'ti dhātu vuttā.
yajjevaṃ “sīho nadatī”ti ādīsu tiracchānagatādisaddabhāvena avibhāvitatthatāya nadasaddo abyattasaddo hotu.
“sīho viya ayaṃ puriso nadatī”tiādīsu pana manussabhāsāpi abyattasaddo siyāti?
viyattāpi samānā manussabhāsā sīho viyāti evaṃ samupekkhāvasena sīhapadatthassāpekkhanato nadasaddena niddisiyati, na purisāpekkhanavasena.

yathā hi valāhakūpamāvasena kathitaṃ “kathañca puggalo gajjitā ca vassitā ca hotī”ti pāḷiyaṃ gajjanaṃ vassanañca puggale alabbhamānampi valāhakassa gajjanavassanasadisatāya bhāsanakaraṇakriyāyupalabbhanato vattabbameva hoti.
evameva nibbhayabhāvena sīhanādasadisiyā vācāya niccharaṇato sīho viya nadatīti avibhāvitatthavantena nadasaddena manussabhāsāpi niddisitabbā hoti.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: evaṃ santepi bhagavatā aññenākārena sadisattaṃ vibhāvetuṃ ambaphalūpamādayo vuttā.
evameva nadasaddo abyattasaddabhāvena tiracchānagatasaddādīsu eva vattabbopi atthantaravibhāvanatthaṃ “sīho viya nadatī”tiādīsu manussabhāsāyampi ruḷhiyā vutto, na sabhāvato.
tathā hi sabhāvato nadasaddenapi vassitasaddādīhipi manussabhāsā niddisitabbā na hotīti.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: sakuṇānañca vassita”nti vassitasaddavasena payogassa vacanato tadanurūpaṃ niddisituṃ arahatīti mantvā vassitasaddasadisī niddiṭṭhā.na hi “manusso vassatī”tiādinā visuṃ payogā dissanti.
sīhanādaṃ nadi kuso”tiādīsu [jā. 2. 73.] viya yathārahaṃ attho gahetabbo.
evaṃ nadadhātu sabhāvato abyattasaddeyeva hoti, na viyattiyaṃ vācāyanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
ettha ca abyattasaddabhāvo manussānaṃ vasena vutto.
sakasakabhāvena pana attano attano ñāṇe byattoyeva nāma hotīti veditabbaṃ.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: idāni jāyamānakkhaṇeyeva vācaṃ nicchāretuṃ samatthe attabhāve saṅgahetvā dassetuṃ vuttaṃ “bodhisatto hī”tiādi.
mātukucchito nikkhantamattova vācaṃ nicchāresīti ettha nikkhantamatteyeva ekaṃ vācaṃ nicchāresi.
tato aparaṃ pana aññehi sadisoyeva hutvā vattatīti veditabbaṃ.
tasmiṃyeva samayeti tasmiṃyeva bodhisattassa jāyamānakkhaṇeyeva apubbe acarime.
apare pana “thokaṃ bodhisattassa carimaṃ hutvā rāhulamātādayo jāyanti.
jātadivasassa pana sadisatāya sahajātā nāmā”ti vadanti.
so pana taṃ taṃ pāpakammaṃ katvā “kiṃ pana tvaṃ idaṃ karosī”ti aññehi pucchito “ahaṃ na karomī”ti evaṃ paṭicchannakammatāya “channo”ti vohariṃsu.
so pana ābhuso nanditabboti katvā “ānando”ti vuccati.
aparesaṃ pana vāde thokaṃ carimabhāvena jātattā kaniṭṭho ahosīti daṭṭhabbo.
so pana uccabhāvena ayati pavattatīti “udāyī”ti vuccati.
vaṇṇato pana thokaṃ kāḷatāya “kāḷudāyī”ti pacchā samaññā ahosi.
kaṇḍako assarājāti kaṇḍati verino chindati abhibhavatīti “kaṇḍako”ti evaṃ samaññā sindhavajātiyaṃ jāto assarājā.
catasso nidhikumbhiyoti saṅkho elo uppalo puṇḍarīkoti catasso nidhikumbhiyo.
heṭṭhimato pana tā heṭṭhā pathavitalaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhantīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ime satta sahajātā nāmāti ime yathāvuttā rāhulamātādayo sahajātā nāma.

yaṃ pana aṅguttaranikāyaṭṭhakathāyaṃ -- “bodhisattena hi saddhiṃ bodhirukkho rāhulamātā catasse nidhikumbhiyo ārohaniyahatthī kaṇḍako channo kāḷudāyīti ime satta ekadivase jātattā sahajātā nāma ahesu”nti [aṃ. ṭṭha. 1. 234.] vuttaṃ.
aṅguttaranikāyabhāṇakā hi kira “ānandatthero pacchā jāto kaniṭṭho”ti āhaṃsu.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: bodhisattassa pādā parivattitvāti mahāpurisassa dve pādā parivattitvā vijjulatā viya asitajaladharakūṭesu tāpasassa jaṭāsu patiṭṭhahiṃsu.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: catujjātikagandhehīti kāḷānusārī tagaraṃ kappūraṃ sāracandananti imehi catujjātikagandhehi vilimpitvā.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: chaḷaṅgatamanta [chaḷaṅgavāmantaṃ. jā. ṭṭha. 1. 66.] nti cha aṅgāni etassa mantassāti chaḷaṅgato.
chaḷaṅgato ca so manto cāti chaḷaṅgatamanto.
tesu satta janāti tesu aṭṭhasu brāhmaṇesu rāmādayo satta janā dve aṅguliyo ukkhipitvā dvedhā byākariṃsu.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: rājūnaṃ hi sabbesaṃ paveṇiyā āgatavasena jeṭṭhamāse vappamaṅgalaṃ nāma ahosīti.
ettha hi ṭhānīvasena ṭhānassa nāmaṃ vuttaṃ.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: anekasahassesu bhavesu kataparicayavasena ānāpānakammaṭṭhānassa pariggahaṇe bodhisattānaṃ aggapuggalānaṃ bhāro na hoti.
taṃ pana kammaṭṭhānaṃ pariggahetvā nibbattapaṭhamajjhānaṃ vuddhakāle anekehi kāmaguṇehi upakkiliṭṭhattā antaradhāyi.
puna mahābodhimaṇḍe taṃ uppajjīti vadanti ācariyā.
tañca pāṭihāriyanti tassa rukkhassa parimaṇḍalavasena ṭhitabhāvasaṅkhātaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ disvā.
dutiyaṃ vandananti kāḷadevilatāpasassa añjaliṃ paggahetvā patiṭṭhānabhāvaṃ disvā vandanaṃ upanidhāya idaṃ vandanaṃ dutiyaṃ ahosi.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: kāresīti bodhisatte kira soḷasavassuddesike jāte suddhodanamahārājā “puttassa vasanakapāsāde kāressāmī”ti vaddhakino sannipātāpetvā bhaddakena nakkhattamuhuttena abhinavabhūmiparikammaṃ kāretvā tayo pāsāde kārāpesi.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: ekaṃ navabhūmikanti rammo nāma eko pāsādo navabhūmiko.
ekaṃ sattabhūmikanti subho nāma eko pāsādo sattabhūmiko.
ekaṃ pañcabhūmikanti surammo nāma eko pāsādo pañcabhūmiko.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: nippurisehi tūriyehīti ekassāpi purisassa tattha abhāvato purisavirahitehi tūriyehi.
rājā kira “tathārūpaṃ issariyasukhasampattiṃ anubhavamānassa purisaṃ disvā purisāsaṅkā uppajjati.
sā me puttassa mā ahosī”ti sabbakiccesu itthiyova ṭhapesi.
utuvārena tesu pāsādesu viharatīti hemantakāle navabhūmike viharati.
evaṃ utuvārena tesu tīsu pāsādesu viharatīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tattha ca hemantiko pāsādo navabhūmiko ahosi.
cittakammampi karontā tattha tattha pajjalite aggikkhandheyeva akaṃsu.
vātapānāni uṇhaggāhāpanatthaṃ divā vivaṭāni rattiṃ pihitāni honti.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: sītaütuggāhāpanatthaṃ panettha bhūmiyo uccā asambādhā ahesuṃ.
cittakamme uppalāni padumāni puṇḍarikāni yeva akaṃsu.
vātapānasamīpesu cettha navacāṭiyo ṭhapetvā udakassa pūretvā nīluppalādīhi sañchādenti.
yehi deve vassante viya udakadhārā nikkhamanti.
antopāsāde tattha tattha kalalapurā doṇiyo ṭhapetvā pañcavaṇṇāni padumāni ropayiṃsu.
pāsādamatthake sukkhamahiṃsacammaṃ bandhitvā yantaṃ bandhitvā parivattetvā yāva chadanapiṭṭhiyā pāsāṇe āropetvā tasmiṃ vissajjenti.
tesaṃ camme pavaṭṭentānaṃ saddo meghagajjitaṃ viya hoti.
dvāravātapānāni panettha divā pihitāni honti rattiṃ vivaṭāni.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: bhūmiyo panettha dvinnampi utūnaṃ gāhāpanatthāya nātiuccā nātinīcā akaṃsu.
tattha cittakammampi kesuci ṭhānesu pajjalitaaggikkhandhavasena, kesuci jātassaravasena kataṃ.
ekaccāni dvāravātapānāni rattiṃ vivaṭāni divā pihitāni.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: tassevaṃ mahāsampattiṃ anubhavantassa ekadivasaṃ ñātisaṃghassa abbhantare ayaṃ kathā udapādīti evaṃ niṭṭhitesu pāsādesu rājā cintesi “putto me vayappatto.
so sākiyānaṃ paṇṇāni pahiṇi “putto me vayappatto.
sabbe attano attano gehesu vayappattā dārikā imaṃ gehaṃ pesentū”ti.
te rañño sāsanaṃ sutvā “kumāro kevalaṃ dassanakkhamo rūpasampanno.
saṅgāme paccupaṭṭhite kiñci kātuṃ na sakkhissati.
evaṃ ñātisaṃghassa abbhantare ayaṃ kathā udapādīti.
taṃ kathanākāraṃ pana saṅkhepena dassetuṃ -- “siddhatthe kīḷāpasuto”tiādimāha.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: rājā bodhisattaṃ pakkosāpetvāti rājā taṃ pavattiṃ sutvā puttassa samīpaṃ gantvā tattha ṭhatvā bodhisattaṃ pakkosāpetvā tamatthaṃ ārocesīti attho.
tathā hi vuttaṃ aṅguttaranikāyaṭṭhakathādīsu -- “rājā taṃ pavattiṃ sutvā puttassa santikaṃ gantvā tamatthaṃ ārocesī”ti. [aṃ. ṭṭha. 2. 127.] tadārocanākāraṃ dasseti “tātā”tiādinā.
ettha kiṃ samatthakāle maññasīti imasmiṃ ñātisamūhe taṃ taṃ sippaṃ jānituṃ samatthakāle kiṃ nāma sippaṃ tvaṃ jānāsīti attho.
atha vā imasmiṃ kathāya uppajjanakakāle taṃ taṃ sippaṃ jānituṃ samatthakāle sampatte kiṃ maññasīti attho.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: mama sippaṃ sikkhanakiccaṃ natthīti ettha bodhisattānaṃ paripakkapāramīñāṇasambhārānaṃ puggalavisesānaṃ atidaharakāleyeva tesu tesu bhavesu anekasahassesu kataparicayavasena ānāpāne pariggahetvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ nibbattetuṃ tāva samattho hoti.
lokiyasippaṃ pana hatthiassarathasippādikaṃ jānituṃ bhāro natthiyevāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: dvādasavidhaṃ sippaṃ dassetīti bodhisatto “kiṃ sippaṃ dassetuṃ vaṭṭati tātā”ti āha.

mahāpuriso taṃ dhanuṃ āharāpetvā pallaṅkena nisinnova jiyaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhakena veṭhetvā kaḍḍhanto pādaṅguṭṭhakeneva dhanuṃ āropetvā vāmena hatthena daṇḍaṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena kaḍḍhitvā jiyaṃ pothesi.
“kiṃ saddo eso”ti ca vutte “devo gajjatī”ti āhaṃsu.
aṅgīrasassa kumārassa sahassathāmadhanuṃ āropetvā jiyaṃ pothentassa jiyappahārasaddo eso”ti āhaṃsu.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: atha mahāpuriso “aññaṃ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āha.
taṃ vinivijjhitvā “aññaṃ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āha.
tampi vinivijjhitvā “aññaṃ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āha.
tampi vinivijjhitvā “aññaṃ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āha.
tampi vinivijjhitvā “aññaṃ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āha.
tampi vinivijjhitvā “aññaṃ kiṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āha.
mahāsatto vālikasakaṭampi palālasakaṭampi vinivijjhitvā udake ekūsabhappamāṇaṃ kaṇḍaṃ pesesi.
atha naṃ “idāni vātiṅgaṇasaññāya vālaṃ vinivijjhituṃ vaṭṭatī”ti āhaṃsu.
yojanamatthake vātiṅgaṇasaññāya vālaṃ bandhāpetvā rattandhakāre meghapaṭalasañchanne samaye saraṃ paṭikkhipi.
so gantvā yojanamatthake vālaṃ phāletvā pathaviṃ pāvisi.
taṃdivasaṃ pana mahāsatto loke vattamānasippaṃ sabbameva dassesi.
aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana taṃ sabbaṃ upari sarabhaṅgajātake āgatanayena niddisituṃ “taṃ sarabhaṅgajātake āgatanayeneva veditabba”nti āha.
idha pana tivaṅguttaraṭṭhakathāyaṃ buddhavaṃsaṭṭhakathāyañca vuttanayena evaṃ saṃvaṇṇema.
sakyarājāno pana tadā nikkaṅkhā hutvā attano attano dhītaro alaṅkaritvā pesayiṃsu.
taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ “tadā ñātisaṃgho nikkaṅkho ahosī”ti.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: pavedhamānanti kampamānaṃ katvā ekaṃ devaputtaṃ dassesuṃ devatāti sambandho.

before.title: avidūrenidānakathāvaṇṇanā
lines: taṃ bodhisatto ceva sārathi ca passantīti iminā “aññe balakāyā passantī”ti atthaṃ nisedheti.
dhīratthu vata bho jātinti samma sārathi jāti nāma dhī atthu vatāti attho.
